jobs.title: Project Coordinator II
jobs.description:
**Join the Sigler family!**

Russell Sigler Inc., headquartered in Tolleson, Arizona, has been an independent distributor of industry\-leading Carrier products for over 50 years throughout the Southwestern US. In 2012, Sigler received the ACE award for the fastest growing privately owned business in Arizona. In 2010, in a joint venture with Carrier Air Conditioning, Sigler acquired the California territory making Sigler one of the largest HVAC distributors in the world.

Sigler employees have the choice of many benefit options, including Medical, Vision, Dental, Life insurance, Long and Short Term Disability, Long Term Care, Critical Illness and Accident insurance. Additional benefits include a Health Savings Account (HSA), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), 401(k), Profit Sharing, 401(k) Matching, Pet Insurance, Legal Shield/Prepaid Legal, paid vacation, sick leave and holidays.

**Position Summary:**

Project Coordinator II provides assistance in the scheduling, reporting, and quality control functions of all Commercial project activities of varying size and complexity.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:** 

* Analyze project requirements while evaluating and recommending sound approaches or applications to meet the needs of projects and clients
* Coordinate project activities and request for changes from original specifications
* Act as liaison between Sales, Order Fulfillment, Contractors, Engineering, Vendors, Factories, and Transport Companies.
* Consistently maintain digital job files with appropriate supporting documents
* Maintain intimate knowledge of clients’ project schedule requirements from sales teams and contractor feedback
* Manage risk and establish project recovery plans
* ·Maintain projects in Sharepoint
* ·Provide job account documentation to the credit department
* Update jobs on order sheets and send to customers through Sharepoint
* Reconcile project close out and provide partial or full releases to A/R
* Interact and support outside sales employees, engineers, and technical associates as assigned by department supervisor
* Responsible for accuracy in all aspects of the jobs from creation until all orders are closed
* Coordinate deliveries and crane meets/lifts
* Track, monitor and handle order revisions (deductions and additions)
* Handle credit and rebills, concessions and proof of deliveries
* Support and file freight claims
* Assist customers and credit department with credit holds, CODs, and credit card payment information
* Review part numbers and pricing

**Critical Knowledge and Skills:**

* Strong interpersonal, organizational and communication skills with the ability to work with cross functional teams
* Good time management and follow\-up skills
* Proficient in MS Project and MS Office Suite
* Accurate data entry skills
* Ability to multitask, be organized, pay attention to detail, and resolve issues
* Work independently with minimal supervision in fast paced work environment
* Research using HVAC Partners with access to ECAT, QuotePro and CarrierAppsHub systems and software to obtain product guides, information, catalogs and manufacturing literature
* Respond effectively to daily issues
* Establish facts and draw valid conclusions; create and execute plans
* Reliable, ability to work hours dictated by the demands of the position
* Required to learn HVAC Carrier Products and software (Sage, HVAC Partners, and vendor websites)
* Able to understand or learn mechanical schedule specification interpretation
* Work in a constant state of alertness and safe manner

**Experience:**

* Required experience in an operational position with high\-speed input/output
* AA/AS\-BA/BS degree or related experience in the HVAC industry preferred

**Work type:** Staff  

**Location:** Long Beach  

**Categories:** Unit 4 \- APC \- Academic Professionals of California, Administrative, Temporary, Full Time  

Join the vibrant community at California State University, Long Beach (CSULB)!



Located just three miles from the Pacific Ocean, CSULB offers an inspiring workplace and an exceptional Southern California lifestyle. Our 322\-acre campus—one of the largest in the CSU system—serves more than 42,000 students and is known for its commitment to student success, innovation, and impactful academic and research initiatives.



As a member of the CSULB community, you’ll experience a dynamic environment filled with cultural landmarks, collaborative energy, and opportunities to make a meaningful difference.



Work\-life balance thrives here. Long Beach blends coastal relaxation with urban vibrancy, offering miles of beaches, year\-round sunshine, a thriving arts and food scene, and convenient access to both Los Angeles and Orange County. It’s an ideal place to grow your career while enjoying everything Southern California has to offer.



Join the California State University (CSU) and explore career opportunities that advance student success and strengthen California’s future—offering competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and professional growth.

The Financial Aid Counselor/Program Coordinator performs a variety of processing and specialized financial aid functions to facilitate administration of financial aid programs and delivery of funds to students in support of access and student success. Activities include determining eligibility; awarding aid; facilitating problem solving with students and parents; and making professional judgment decisions regarding student aid eligibility. The counselor provides leadership and program oversight over an assigned area of specialty; adjudicates appeals; and provides training to other staff.



Furthermore, this position provides services that are equitable, inclusive, and culturally sensitive to enhance the quality of campus life. This position uses a student\-centered and equity\-minded approach in all communication and service efforts, whether in\-person, via phone or through written correspondence.

* Counseling and Outreach: Promote an environment of collaboration and service excellence by providing a broad range of student and family\-facing financial aid services, including counseling and outreach activities.
* Processing, Evaluation, Program Oversight: Provide leadership; program management; and serve as liaison for a programmatic area of specialization. * Knowledge and Continual Learning: Remain current with constantly evolving financial aid regulations (federal, state, institutional) and emerging trends and best practices in delivering service excellence. Contribute to the overall success of the Financial Aid Office and Enrollment Services through ad\-hoc assignments.

Enrollment Services \- Financial Aid



### **Time Base**



1\.0 time\-base, 40 hours per week.



### **Duration of Appointment**



This is a temporary position for 1 year with no permanent status granted. Temporary assignments may expire prior to the ending date.



### **Classification**



Student Services Professional II

Salary placement is determined by the education, experience, and qualifications the candidate brings to the position, internal equity, and the hiring department’s fiscal resources.

jobs.title: Strategic Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**

The Niles Foundation (TNF) is a community\-based nonprofit organization working to advance environmental justice, food security, clean mobility, climate resilience, economic opportunity, and community well\-being.

Through initiatives such as the Halo Food Project, EVCLEAN15, community engagement programs, leadership development efforts, and climate resilience initiatives, TNF works alongside residents, partners, and stakeholders to create meaningful opportunities and lasting community impact.***\*\*\*Only serious candidates apply.***

**Position Summary**

The Strategic Operations Coordinator supports the daily operations and organizational activities of The Niles Foundation.

This role helps maintain organizational continuity by supporting communications, community engagement activities, events, administrative functions, and operational coordination across TNF initiatives. The Strategic Operations Coordinator works closely with the Director and team members to help ensure that projects, partnerships, events, and organizational priorities continue moving forward efficiently.

This position is ideal for someone who is dependable, organized, eager to learn, able to work independently, and enjoys being part of a collaborative team environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Administrative \& Organizational Support*

* Coordinate meetings and scheduling.
* Maintain organized digital files and records.
* Track action items, deadlines, and follow\-up tasks.
* Maintain contact lists and organizational databases.
* Assist with data entry and general administrative support.
* Help ensure important communications and commitments stay organized and on schedule.

*Communications Support*

* Respond to routine inquiries and requests.
* Assist with communications to community members, volunteers, partners, and stakeholders.
* Prepare reminders, updates, and meeting communications.
* Support outreach and engagement efforts.

*Community \& Event Support*

* Assist with community events, workshops, meetings, and outreach activities.
* Help coordinate volunteer communications and event registrations.
* Support event logistics and participant engagement.
* Assist with surveys, sign\-ins, and community data collection activities.

*Operations Support*

* Support organizational systems and processes.
* Assist with project tracking and coordination.
* Help maintain organizational continuity and follow\-through.
* Support special projects and emerging organizational needs as assigned.

**Qualifications**

*Minimum Qualifications*

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or similar tools.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on assignments.
* Ability to work efficiently and independently.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience in customer service, administration, nonprofit work, community engagement, events, education, public service, or related fields.
* Experience coordinating meetings, volunteers, events, community activities, or projects.
* Experience working with diverse communities.
* Bilingual skills are a plus but not required.

**Entry\-level and experienced candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.**

**Who We're Looking For**

We're less concerned about finding the "perfect" candidate and more interested in finding the right person.

The ideal candidate is:

* Reliable and dependable
* Honest and trustworthy
* Self\-motivated and proactive
* Organized and detail\-oriented
* Able to work efficiently and independently
* Comfortable taking initiative and solving problems
* Professional and respectful in communications
* Works well in collaborative team environments
* Willing to learn new skills and take on new responsibilities
* Able to adapt to changing priorities
* Passionate about community\-centered work

**We value integrity, accountability, communication, teamwork, and a willingness to learn just as much as prior experience.**

*If you don't meet every qualification listed but believe you would be a strong fit for this role, we encourage you to apply.*

**Local Candidates Strongly Encouraged to Apply**

The Niles Foundation is committed to creating meaningful employment opportunities within the communities we serve.

We strongly encourage applications from local residents and individuals with ties to Los Angeles County and surrounding communities. As a community\-based organization, we believe investing in local talent strengthens our programs, partnerships, and long\-term impact.

**Relocation assistance is not available.**

Pay: $21\.00 \- $23\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15\.0 – 20\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Tour Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

The Tour Operations Coordinator will report directly to the Chief Operating Officer and play a key role in the planning and preparation of our events.

This position will be responsible for managing venue and hotel logistics from initial sourcing through final reconciliation. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable managing multiple events simultaneously, confident communicating with hotels and venues, and capable of maintaining accurate budgets, contracts, deadlines, and operational documentation.

Strong follow\-through, attention to detail, financial awareness, and the ability to proactively identify potential issues are essential for success in this role.

**Key ResponsibilitiesVenue Coordination**

* Research, identify, and evaluate potential venues for regional and national events based on event requirements, availability, location, capacity, and budget.
* Manage the venue sourcing and booking process, including inquiries, proposals, negotiations, contract review, date holds, and securing event dates.
* Maintain ongoing communication with venue contacts throughout the planning process to provide event details, schedules, Certificates of Insurance, and other required documentation.
* Request, collect, review, and organize necessary venue documentation, including but not limited to, floorplans, technical specifications, riser charts, power information, security policies, loading information, and venue guidelines.
* Coordinate venue\-related logistics including ballroom and exhibit hall holds, load\-in and load\-out requirements, AV regulations, labor requirements, union guidelines, security, cleaning, HVAC, power, and other operational needs.
* Work closely with the production team, logistics and event directors to gather venue information and assist in the creation and distribution of venue diagrams, info sheets, show documents, and other event materials.
* Maintain accurate venue budgets for each event, including projected costs, contracted costs, deposits, additional expenses, and final actual spend.
* Track projected versus actual event expenses throughout the planning cycle and maintain accurate, up\-to\-date event cost totals.
* Review venue invoices for accuracy, reconcile final charges against contracted rates and approved expenses, and identify billing discrepancies before payment.
* Track important contractual deadlines including deposits, payment schedules, cancellation dates, insurance requirements, and other venue obligations.
* Maintain organized records of venue contracts, proposals, invoices, floorplans, payment schedules, and supporting event documentation.

**Hotel Coordination**

* Research and source hotels capable of accommodating staff, judges, crew, and other traveling team members for each event.
* Request hotel proposals and negotiate group room blocks, room rates, concessions, amenities, complimentary rooms, upgrades, parking, meeting space, and contract terms.
* Maintain ongoing communication with hotel sales and event managers leading up to each event to confirm rooming lists, check\-in arrangements, billing instructions, arrival details, and special requests.
* Coordinate lodging logistics for traveling team members and ensure accurate rooming lists are prepared, updated, and submitted within required deadlines.
* Monitor hotel room block pickup and proactively manage potential attrition, overages, room shortages, and other contractual concerns.
* Track and confirm fulfillment of negotiated hotel concessions including complimentary rooms, credits, upgrades, amenities, parking, meeting space, and other contracted benefits.
* Develop and maintain hotel budgets for each event, including projected room costs, taxes, fees, concessions, and anticipated lodging expenses.
* Track projected lodging costs against actual hotel spend and update totals as rooming needs, rates, and billing details change.
* Track hotel contractual deadlines including rooming list due dates, cutoff dates, deposit requirements, cancellation terms, attrition dates, and payment schedules.
* Review final hotel invoices and folios for accuracy, reconcile charges against contracted rates and approved rooming lists, and identify discrepancies prior to payment.

**Budgeting, Tracking \& Administration**

* Maintain centralized event trackers containing venue and hotel status, contracted costs, projected expenses, actual expenses, payment deadlines, contractual obligations, and outstanding action items.
* Assist with tour\-wide budgeting and forecasting by compiling anticipated venue and hotel expenses across the annual event calendar.
* Coordinate deposits, payment requests, and final billing documentation with the accounting team to ensure payments are submitted accurately and on time.
* Conduct post\-event financial reconciliation and maintain historical venue and hotel cost data to improve budgeting and sourcing decisions for future events.
* Compare historical, projected, and actual event costs to identify trends, cost increases, savings opportunities, and areas requiring additional review.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs through negotiations, concessions, alternative sourcing options, and long\-term venue and hotel relationships.
* Maintain organized and accessible records for each event to ensure contracts, financial information, venue documentation, hotel information, and operational materials remain current and complete.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Event Management, Hospitality, Business, Operations, or a related field preferred but not required; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Previous experience in event planning, hospitality, venue sourcing, hotel sales, group travel, touring operations, or event coordination preferred.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple events and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when reviewin

Vast is developing next\-generation **space stations and space infrastructure** using an incremental, hardware\-rich, and low\-cost approach. Haven Demo's 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven\-1 is expected to become the world's first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced **Vast Satellite**, a high\-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.



Headquartered in **Long Beach, California**, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America's next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long\-term space economy.

jobs.description:

EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

WORK ENVIRONMENT

jobs.title: Social Media & Digital Communications Specialist
jobs.description:
**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**



Rocket Lab is the end\-to\-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**SOCIAL MEDIA \& DIGITAL COMMUNICATIONS SPECIALIST**

The Rocket Lab communications team translates literal rocket science into impactful and compelling stories that captivate the globe. We are looking for a Social Media \& Digital Communications Specialist who lives and breathes digital storytelling, thrives in high\-stakes environments, and wants to run one of the most exciting feeds in space. This is not a cruise\-control 9\-to\-5\. Rockets launch at 3:00 AM, mission milestones happen in real\-time across multiple time zones, and the unexpected is around every corner. If you want a comfortable corporate routine, this isn't it. If you want to shape the voice of a company shaping humanity's future in space, read on.


**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* **Build the Content Engine:** Plan, maintain, and execute an aggressive digital editorial calendar aligned with missions, program milestones, and strategic company goals.
* **Own the Channels**: Lead day\-to\-day execution across X, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, subscriber newsletters and emerging platforms.
* **Understand the Audience:** Tailor content to our broad range of audiences spanning B2B and B2G, talent candidates, investors, and fans.
* **Cover the Action in Real Time:** Work with our media content producers to capture, package, and publish live coverage for launches, hot fires, spacecraft deployments, trade shows, and major company milestones.
* **Translate Rocket Science**: Partner directly with engineers, mission operators, and production teams to turn complex technical achievements into sharp, accessible content.
* **Drive Growth with Data:** Monitor platform analytics, spot trends before they fade, experiment with AI tools and new formats, and ruthlessly optimize for reach and engagement.
* **Guard the Brand Voice:** Ensure every caption, clip, graphic, and post matches Rocket Lab's standard of quality, technical accuracy, and unmistakable tone.
* **Expand the Frontier:** Challenge the status quo of how aerospace communicates. Bring fresh tech, unconventional distribution strategies, and bold creative experiments that keep us leagues ahead of the industry.
* **Roll Your Sleeves Up:** This isn't a pure strategy role insulated from the execution. You are on the tools every single day, drafting, shooting, editing, and driving projects from concept to feed. You can expect to live tweet countdowns, get out onto the factory floor to get the story, write the post, and hit publish yourself.


**YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 5\+ years of experience. Proven track record running high\-growth, high\-engagement social channels and digital campaigns for a fast\-moving brand.
* A sharp portfolio with direct proof of killer campaigns you built and executed personally.
* Experience in both organic and paid social campaigns and strategies. Deep understanding of how to roll out effective paid social and digital campaigns to serve specific business needs.
* Flexibility to travel and move fast: Ready to support on\-site activations, events, and dynamic launch schedules across time zones.


 **THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Bachelors degree.
* Ability to distil complex ideas into short, witty, punchy copy with zero fluff and flawless attention to detail.
* Extreme ownership. You don't wait for a brief. You spot what needs doing, hunt for an answer, pick up a camera, or open a draft, and get it done.
* Calm, decisive judgment when breaking news hits or launch countdowns are ticking live.
* Experience in aerospace, defence, motorsport or tech industries.
* An authentic obsession with space exploration and technology.
* You don't have to be able to have hands on photo/video capture and mobile editing skills but it would be beneficial.
* Experience in a start\-up environment


*This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.*

**WHAT TO EXPECT**



We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out\-think, out\-work, and out\-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.



Important information:


**FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:**


*To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. **Company Overview:**

OneStop Rentals is a Los Angeles\-based professional cinema equipment rental house providing cameras, lenses, lighting, and production gear. This is not a position focused solely on sitting at a desk and scheduling social media posts. We are looking for someone who takes initiative—someone who notices an interesting camera build, lens test, client prep, or piece of equipment and sees an opportunity to turn it into engaging content.

* Monitor opportunities to tag participating clients, cinematographers, filmmakers, production companies, manufacturers, or collaborators when appropriate.

Not every piece of content needs to be published immediately.

The employee will also be responsible for developing and maintaining an organized **Client Clip Library** within the company's designated cloud storage system.

Responsibilities include:

* Uploading usable photographs and video clips to the company's designated OneDrive folders.
* Organizing footage so that content can be easily located and reused.
* Identifying the client, project, equipment, or general subject of footage where appropriate.
* Separating published content from unused content when practical.
* Preserving high\-quality footage for future Instagram Stories, Reels, promotional videos, and other marketing purposes.
* Building a reserve of content that can be published during slower rental days when there may be few or no active client preps.

Candidates should understand that **capturing more quality content than is immediately needed is encouraged**. A strong archive gives the company greater flexibility to maintain consistent marketing activity throughout the week.

Client Outreach \& Business Development

A major component of this position is proactive client outreach.

The employee will help OneStop maintain existing industry relationships while identifying potential new clients throughout the Los Angeles filmmaking community.

Outreach may be conducted through:

* Instagram direct messages;
* Email;
* Telephone calls; and
* Other company\-approved communication channels.

Potential outreach targets include:

* Previous OneStop clients who may have upcoming productions or equipment needs;
* Existing OneStop Instagram followers who are located in the Los Angeles area but have not previously rented from the company;

Candidates should be capable of researching a prospective client's work before initiating contact.

jobs.title: Medical Device Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Independent Veterinary Sales Representative – Los Angeles / Southern California**  
**1099 Independent Contractor \| Commission\-Based \| Territory Opportunity**

Alexander International Innovations, LLC is expanding its veterinary sales presence in Southern California and is seeking experienced, relationship\-driven independent sales representatives.

Southern California has one of the largest and most active veterinary markets in the country. We are looking for motivated professionals who understand their local market and are ready to develop a protected territory with significant growth potential.

**About the Opportunity**

You will introduce veterinary hospitals, specialty and emergency practices, general practices, and other animal\-health organizations to I2F®, a patented medical device designed to support more efficient medication preparation, improve vial access, and reduce avoidable medication waste.

This is an independent contractor opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, educating clinical teams, and developing a territory over time. It is especially well suited for an established veterinary, medical, pharmaceutical, or healthcare sales professional who wants to add an innovative product to their portfolio.

This position begins with a focus on veterinary medicine. As AII expands into the human healthcare market following the necessary regulatory clearance, established representatives will have the opportunity to grow with the company and represent I2F within eligible human healthcare accounts.

**Responsibilities**

* Identify and develop prospective veterinary accounts within an assigned Los Angeles/Southern California territory
* Conduct in\-person visits with veterinary hospitals and clinical teams
* Present and demonstrate I2F to veterinarians, veterinary technicians, practice managers, pharmacy personnel, and purchasing decision\-makers
* Develop long\-term relationships with prospective and existing customers
* Follow up on product evaluations, questions, and purchasing opportunities
* Maintain accurate records of contacts, visits, and sales activity in the company CRM
* Represent Alexander International Innovations professionally at local conferences, meetings, and networking events when appropriate
* Collaborate with company leadership and other representatives to support market development

**Who We’re Looking For**

* Previous veterinary, medical device, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or business\-to\-business sales experience preferred
* Existing relationships within the veterinary community are strongly preferred
* Comfortable entering veterinary facilities, initiating conversations, and conducting product demonstrations
* Self\-directed, dependable, and able to manage a territory independently
* Strong communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills
* Consistent follow\-through and willingness to remain engaged throughout the sales process
* Comfortable using email, video meetings, and a web\-based CRM
* Located in the Los Angeles/Southern California area and able to travel locally within the assigned territory
* Access to reliable transportation

**Compensation**

* 1099 independent contractor position
* Commission\-based compensation with uncapped earning potential
* Increased commission opportunity based on sales performance
* No income ceiling
* Territory growth and recurring customer orders can create meaningful long\-term earning potential

**What We Provide**

* A patented, clinically relevant product with applications across veterinary medicine
* Product education, onboarding, and ongoing sales support
* Demonstration materials and professionally developed marketing resources
* Access to company leadership and clinical experts
* CRM access and territory\-development support
* Opportunities to grow alongside an emerging healthcare innovation company
* Protected territory consideration based on performance and continued activity
* Early\-entry opportunity with a growing healthcare innovation company
* Representatives who successfully establish and maintain their veterinary territories will have the opportunity to expand into the human healthcare market following the necessary regulatory clearance and commercial launch
* Future potential to work with hospitals, infusion centers, specialty pharmacies, home infusion providers, and other human healthcare organizations

**About Alexander International Innovations**

Alexander International Innovations, LLC develops innovative solutions for human and veterinary medicine. Our work is driven by clinical experience and a commitment to improving medication preparation, reducing preventable waste, and supporting the responsible stewardship of healthcare resources.

We are building a nationwide network of professionals who believe meaningful healthcare innovation begins by understanding the challenges clinicians face every day.

This position is best suited for someone who wants to actively build a territory.

**To Apply**

Please submit your résumé along with a brief description of:

* Your veterinary, medical, pharmaceutical, or healthcare sales experience
* The Southern California region you currently cover or would like to represent
* Any existing relationships you have within the veterinary community
* Why this independent, commission\-based opportunity interests you

Alexander International Innovations, LLC provides equal opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

**Job Type:** Contract

**Work Location:** Remote with regular local travel throughout the assigned territory

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time, Contract

Pay: $55,532\.11 \- $150,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* B2B sales: 1 year (Preferred)

Location:

* Los Angeles, CA (Required)

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: MATERIALS SALES REPRESENTATIVE
jobs.description:
**Materials Sales Representative**

Precast Concrete Products — Outbound Business Development

**Location:** Pomona, CA (serving Southern \+ Northern California)

**Job type:** Full\-Time

**Pay:** $70,000–$95,000 base salary \+ uncapped commission on the margin you produce

We manufacture precast concrete fence and wall systems at our own plants in Pomona and Hollister — and this role owns selling that product as materials: to contractors, fence dealers, GCs, public agencies, and the architects and engineers who write us into their specs. You'll inherit an active book of business and a standing quote pipeline from day one. This is not a cold\-start territory.

**Who We Are**

American Precast Concrete is a vertically integrated manufacturer of precast concrete fence and wall systems, with our own installation division (Concrete Fence Installers). The materials lane you'll own is a standalone revenue engine: customers who buy our panels, posts, and wall systems and install themselves. We control production, which means you can sell with real answers on lead times, custom work, and delivery.

**What You'll Own**

* **The quote engine:** every qualified materials inquiry gets an accurate, complete quote inside our SLA — correct product, quantities, delivery logistics, and terms, with assumptions documented.
* **Pipeline follow\-through:** disciplined follow\-up on every open quote. Nothing ages out because nobody called back.
* **Outbound growth:** build and work a target list of contractors, dealers, GCs, and agencies. Net\-new accounts are a core measure of this seat, not a side activity.
* **A\&E specification selling:** work with architects and engineers to get our products specified on projects — the long game that fills next year's pipeline.
* **The relationship:** own APC material customer relationships end to end, including warranty and service cases through documented resolution.
* **Clean systems:** complete HubSpot records — every deal has a stage, a next step, and a date.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* 3\+ years selling construction materials or building products (precast, masonry, aggregates, fencing, lumber, or adjacent) with a track record you can talk through in numbers.
* Can read site plans well enough to take off linear footage, heights, and product types for a quote.
* Disciplined CRM habits — you document because it wins deals, not because someone makes you.
* Valid CA driver's license; comfortable with regular customer and site visits.

**Preferred**

* Precast concrete or concrete masonry product knowledge.
* Existing relationships with SoCal or NorCal contractors, fence dealers, or public agencies.
* Experience selling to or through architects/engineers (specification selling).
* Bilingual English/Spanish.
* HubSpot experience.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* $70,000–$95,000 base salary \+ uncapped commission on the margin you produce—final structure discussed at offer.
* Company vehicle or allowance for customer and site visits; phone allowance.
* Paid holidays and PTO.
* An active book of business and live quote pipeline from day one.

**How to Apply**

Reply with your resume and 2–3 sentences on the largest materials account or order you personally landed—what you sold, roughly what it was worth, and how you won it. We move fast: phone screen within days, structured interview and a live work sample at our Pomona plant, and decision within the week.

Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $95,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic\-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position**  

The U.S. ION® Endoluminal Sales Associate reports to the U.S. ION® Endoluminal Program Manager (EPM). The ION® Endoluminal Sales Associate plays a critical role in the early adoption of the Ion® platform in expanding access to minimally invasive care for lung biopsy. This individual will be primarily focused on supporting early sustainable users and programs and the development of KOL’s and programs that can highlight the early clinical, economic and strategic value of ION®.


**Essential Job Duties**

* Provide procedural support to new users to promote safety and effective progression through their learning curves
* Support training activities to include in\-services, training labs, attend first case series and development of teams and programs
* Become a clinical expert in the pulmonary oncology space
* Work alongside ESR’s to collaborate with senior hospital staff and key physicians in the development and execution of a plan to effectively integrate Ion® at new customer sites, ensuring ongoing commitment to and utilization of the system
* Facilitate critical user and procedural data capture to create effective QTI and benchmarking metrics
* Collaboration with daVinci local sales teams to ensure consistent alignment and communication with internal and external stakeholders
* Responsibly manage administrative tasks, SFDC management, submission of expense reports, etc.

### **Qualifications**


**Required Skills and Experience**


* Bachelor’s degree required
* A minimum of 2 years quota\-bearing sales experience
* Proven record of achievement and leadership
* Demonstrated ability to manage complexity and work in an environment of change
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to excel in a high\-energy, fast\-paced environment

The Legal Executive Assistant (LEA) supports lawyers by managing the daily functions of an attorney's practice, allowing them to concentrate on developing and sustaining their practice. Working closely with Site Merchandising and cross\-functional partners, you’ll help ensure products, pricing, promotions, and content are accurately represented across the digital experience.

* Create and maintain products within CMS, PIM, and ecommerce systems across assigned regions and channels.
* Manage product activation and deactivation, launch holds, go\-live timing, and scheduled publishing based on approved merchandising and go\-to\-market plans.
* Execute bulk product uploads and recurring catalog maintenance accurately and on schedule.
* Track launch status, dependencies, risks, and exceptions and communicate updates to key partners.
* Help ensure product information is complete, accurate, and ready for launch.

  


**Pricing, Markdowns \& Promotions**


* Execute approved price changes, markdowns, and promotional pricing according to established business timelines.

* Validate pricing and promotional accuracy before launch, while promotions are live, and after expiration.

* Support product and content launch calendars using established checklists and completion tracking.
* Troubleshoot operational issues and escalate platform or data\-related concerns to the appropriate partners.

* Perform pre\- and post\-launch quality assurance across products, pricing, promotions, inventory visibility, links, imagery, and publishing status.
* Conduct routine site checks to identify and resolve execution issues.
* Document recurring issues, root causes, and corrective actions to improve operational accuracy and consistency.
* Maintain a high level of attention to detail across high\-volume site updates and launches.

  


**Process Improvement**


* Identify manual, repetitive, or error\-prone processes and recommend opportunities to improve speed, accuracy, and scalability.
* Partner with Technology and business teams to improve and automate product setup, pricing, markdown, publishing, promotional, and QA workflows.
* Maintain standard operating procedures, templates, and execution checklists for ecommerce operations.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of ecommerce tools, processes, and ways of working.

  


**What You Bring:**


* 2–4 years of experience in ecommerce operations, catalog operations, digital merchandising, or a related field.
* Hands\-on experience working with ecommerce platforms, CMS/PIM systems, product data, bulk uploads, pricing, or promotional workflows.
* Strong proficiency with Adobe Commerce (Magento), including product setup, publishing, pricing, and promotional execution.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including working with large product files, bulk data updates, validation, and reconciliation.

jobs.description:
Logistics Coordinator (AIR \& Ocean Operations)**Job Description**
===================

**1\. Position Overview**


The Mobile Business Unit supports the global distribution of mobile devices with a focus on speed, reliability, and operational efficiency. The Logistics Coordinator (Air \& Ocean Operations) is responsible for planning, executing, and continuously improving inbound and outbound air and ocean freight operations, ensuring shipments move efficiently from manufacturers to Samsung warehouses and ultimately to customers.


This position requires hands\-on experience in Air or Ocean Freight Operations, along with solid ocean freight knowledge. As our operation supports global transportation across multiple time zones, this position follows a five\-day work schedule that includes weekend shifts based on operational requirements.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**


1\) Planning \& Scheduling

* Create and maintain daily tracking reports for Air Export, Ocean Import and OTR including weekend operations


2\) Port \& Terminal Coordination

* Gather departure information for containers and air cargo at ports, terminals, and airports.
* Monitor and confirm on\-time departures from U.S. Ocean terminals and major airports.
* Coordinate terminal departure schedules with terminal operators and customs brokers.


3\) Movement Monitoring

* Track ocean containers, rail intermodal units, and air shipments in real time.
* Validate Import of Documentation (IOD) and Proof of Delivery (POD) on a daily basis.
* Respond promptly to shipment exceptions requiring immediate attention (e.g., delays, damages, customs hold).


4\) Transload Warehouse Management

* Oversee Transload Warehouse (TW) capacity planning and utilization.
* Manage Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for transload operations (e.g., dwell time, on\-time transload, damage rate).
* Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks and work with warehouse teams to implement corrective actions.


5\) TL OB OTR Dispatch Management

* Schedule and dispatch Truckload (TL) Outbound (OB) orders using the Transportation Management System (TMS).
* Optimize routing and load consolidation to meet service\-level agreements while minimizing transportation costs.


6\) Partner \& Stakeholder Communication

* Serve as the primary point of contact for logistics partners, including carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, internal supply chain teams, and customers.
* Handle claims, documentation, and issue escalations through phone, email, or virtual meetings.


7\) Compliance \& Documentation

* Ensure all shipments comply with international trade regulations, hazardous material requirements, and security standards.
* Maintain accurate records for audits and regulatory inspections.
* Perform other job\-related duties as assigned.


8\) Core Competencies

* Analytical Thinking: Translate large data sets into actionable insights.
* Problem Solving: Quickly identify root causes of operational issues and implement effective solutions.
* Communication: Communicate clearly and effectively with internal teams and external partners.
* Multitasking: Manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ability to Work Under Pressure: Perform effectively in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.

**3\. Requirements (Basic Qualifications)**


1\) Education

* Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.


2\) Experience

* Minimum 6 years of experience in logistics coordination, with a strong focus on international air and ocean freight operations.
* Hands\-on experience in international Air, Ocean, and OTR freight forwarding operations is required
* Proven experience managing transload warehouse operations and Truckload (TL) dispatch.


3\) Industry Knowledge

* Strong understanding of international air and ocean freight regulations, and customs procedures


4\) Technical Skills

* Proficiency with ERP and logistics systems (SAP, TMS, WMS or equivalent).
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP.


5\) Language

* English


6\) Weekend work may be required.


Pay Rate: up to $28\.00 per hour (negotiable)

**Benefits**: Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; paid sick leave; life, accidental death \& dismemberment (AD\&D), and long\-term disability (LTD) insurance; and optional voluntary life/AD\&D coverage. Benefits are subject to eligibility and applicable plan terms.

jobs.title: HR Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**


Provides accurate, responsive, and compliance\-focused support across HR operations and the employee lifecycle. The HR Operations Coordinator processes workforce transactions, responds to employee and leader inquiries, maintains HR records, supports reporting and audits, and coordinates cross\-functional activities involving Human Resources, HR Technology, Payroll, Benefits, Information Technology, Information Security, Legal, and Records Management. The role also supports regulatory remediation activities, including Matters Requiring Attention (MRAs), by helping maintain data inventories, execute approved employee\-data retention and deletion procedures, validate results, and preserve audit evidence.

**Responsibilities:**

* Processes and monitors employee lifecycle transactions, job and organizational changes, contingent worker updates, leaves, terminations, rescissions, and related employee data corrections in Workday and connected service channels.
* Reviews requests for completeness, required approvals, effective dates, supporting documentation, and alignment with established policies, procedures, and service expectations before processing or escalation.
* Responds to routine employee and leader questions through HRConnect, shared inboxes, and other approved support channels; document activity, route complex matters to the appropriate HR partner and follow through to resolution.
* Maintains accurate and confidential personnel records, transaction documentation, acknowledgments, and operational evidence in accordance with company retention, privacy, legal\-hold, and records\-management requirements.
* Supports standard and ad hoc HR reporting, transaction audits, data\-quality reviews, exception tracking, and reconciliations; identify discrepancies and coordinate timely corrections with HR Technology or the responsible business owner.
* Assists with recurring HR programs and operational activities, including performance and compensation cycles, workforce changes, policy acknowledgments, labor\-law posting administration, work authorization tracking, and special projects.
* Partners with HR Technology and IT to troubleshoot system or workflow issues, document defects, test approved changes, and confirm that employee lifecycle processes operate as intended across Workday and downstream systems.
* Prepares process documentation, job aids, control evidence, status updates, and supporting materials for internal audits, external audits, compliance reviews, and management reporting.
* Recommends practical improvements that strengthen accuracy, timeliness, controls, employee experience, and scalability across HR operational processes.
* Supports MRA\-related workstreams involving employee data classification, retention, disposition, deletion, de\-identification, and access controls under the direction of the designated business, application, data, or risk owner.
* Maintains current inventories of HR applications, employee\-data locations, system owners, downstream interfaces, retention requirements, legal hold exceptions, and approved deletion or de\-identification rules.
* Coordinates approved deletion exercises by compiling employee populations, validating exclusions, distributing identifiers only through approved secure methods, tracking completion by system owners, and escalating delays or exceptions.
* Validates that approved HR system purge activities complete successfully and coordinate downstream confirmation, reconciliation, and issue resolution without independently changing legal, retention, security, or data\-classification requirements.
* Collects and organizes evidence of execution, including approvals, population files, validation results, exception logs, system\-owner confirmations, and remediation artifacts, in the designated controlled repository.

  



**Requirements**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* One (1\) \+ years of HR operations, HR coordination, HRIS support, records administration, compliance support, or related experience preferred.
* Experience supporting audits, data\-governance activities, regulatory remediation, or controlled operational processes is preferred.
* Working knowledge of HR operations and employee lifecycle processes; familiarity with Workday or a comparable enterprise HRIS is preferred.
* This is a hybrid position based in Irvine, CA or Chandler, AZ \- requiring two days per week.

Sales \& Client Relationship Coordinator (Part\-time)


**FitWise (by MNT) \| Mill Valley, CA**

Our mission is to empower our community through highly customized care, and we’re looking for a **Sales \& Client Relationship Coordinator** who’s as passionate about people as they are about Pilates, Gyrotonic, and therapeutic massage.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a premium, client\-focused environment. **FitWise is widely recognized for having the most highly skilled instructors in the area, with a trusted reputation that brings in consistent referrals directly from local surgeons, chiropractors, and physical therapists.**



Operating internally as our **Community Manager**, you will be the face and voice of this premium brand. You will be responsible for converting high\-quality incoming leads, building lasting relationships, and selling customized private/duet packages to help clients establish a consistent, regular practice. You will also seamlessly guide clients who are ready for group fitness toward memberships at our sister studio, **MNT**. If you are a natural conversationalist, goal\-oriented, and highly organized, we’d love to meet you.

**Lead Conversion \& Package Sales**

* **Proactively monitor client engagement** and reach out to keep individuals inspired, accountable, and consistent with their appointments.
* **Build strong relationships** that naturally lead to word\-of\-mouth referrals and deep studio loyalty.

**Studio Operations \& Administrative Support**


* **Maintain a clean, organized, and inviting environment** across the main studio and our brand\-new private massage room.
* **Support local marketing efforts, studio events, and community partnerships** within Mill Valley.
* **Professionally manage front\-desk tasks**, including phone calls, emails, and complex multi\-modality scheduling inquiries.

What You Bring to the Team


* **Sales\-Driven Mindset:** You genuinely enjoy consultative selling, converting leads, closing package sales, and hitting performance metrics.
* **Experience in Boutique Wellness:** Prior knowledge of Pilates, Gyrotonic, group fitness, or bodywork is a strong plus.
* **Strong Communication:** Confident on the phone, polished in person, and clear in writing.
* **Tech\-Savvy:** Highly comfortable navigating CRM and scheduling tools. Experience with **Mindbody** is highly preferred; familiarity with Mariana Tek is a plus.
* **Solutions\-Oriented:** A quick thinker with a natural focus on delivering high\-end, seamless client experiences.
* **People\-Person:** High energy, approachable, empathetic, and genuinely passionate about community connection.
* **Schedule \& Flexibility:** Looking for approximately **10 hours per week** to start, with the expectation to pick up additional shifts as needed and work occasional studio events (which may include some weekends).

Why Join FitWise (by MNT)?


* **Competitive Pay:** $20–$22/hour based on experience, plus incentive opportunities.
* **Growth Potential:** Be part of a supportive, career\-focused team backed by the established MNTSTUDIO family.
* **Fitness Perks:** Enjoy access to our beautiful space and **significantly reduced rates on Pilates privates and group classes** at our sister studio to stay inspired and strong.
* **Positive Culture:** Work in a beautiful sanctuary where wellness, professionalism, and community thrive.

If you're passionate about relationship\-based sales, premium wellness, and building meaningful connections, this is your opportunity to make a real impact. Help us grow the FitWise and MNT communities while growing your own career.


**Apply today and bring your energy, expertise, and heart to FitWise (by MNT) Mill Valley!**

Technical Account Manager

BAY AREA · NORTHERN CALIFORNIA FULL\-TIME BASE \+ MILESTONE BONUSES \+ UNCAPPED COMMISSION

01\. ABOUT US

Trilion Quality Systems is a precision metrology and NDE company based in King of Prussia, PA, and the US representative for ZEISS IQS optical testing systems. Our sister company, Xi Analytics, develops real\-time optical metrology and AI\-based measurement technology for advanced material testing and aerospace structural applications.

As the exclusive ZEISS Certified Metrology Partner in North America, Trilion’s experienced team of thirty people has spent the last 30 years doing one thing: connecting physical measurement with certified digital insight. More than 90% of the top ten US aerospace, automotive, biomechanics, and electronics companies work with us as their ZEISS DIC partner. This means that you will spend most weeks on innovative projects at Fortune 100 aerospace, defense, automotive, and consumer electronics companies, on test articles that are usually confidential, and you will be the person they call first. We’re an agile team and you won’t waste months waiting on committees and layers of management.

02\. ABOUT THE ROLE

Trilion is opening a Bay Area office around San Mateo in 2026 and hiring a Technical Account Manager to carry Northern California. This is a quota\-carrying, field\-based role, and you will be the primary technical and commercial contact for customers in the territory from the first conversation through demonstration, proposal, purchase order, and long\-term account growth.

You will spend most of your week in front of engineers in their test labs, not behind a desk. Optical metrology is sold by showing it, so much of the job is setting up a system on a customer's test article and letting the data make the argument. Strain gauges read a handful of points and miss the concentrations and asymmetries that decide whether a design passes certification. Full\-field DIC makes every pixel a measurement point, in 3D, NIST\-traceable, and ready for FEA correlation in minutes.

You will not be just a coordinator who forwards technical questions. Once ramped, you are expected to be able to run standard demonstrations and beginner trainings yourself, with our expert engineering team behind you for complex projects, dedicated multi\-day training, and on\-site service work. The technical credibility that comes with it is how you sell on results and direct knowledge rather than on a brochure.

You will not be working a blank list. Leads reach you through ZEISS and through Trilion’s own marketing, and you will generate the rest yourself at proven trade shows, through customer referrals, and by developing accounts we already serve. Revenue splits close to evenly three ways: new accounts, new teams inside existing accounts, and recurring business from our customer base. This means that a majority of projects will come from customers who already know and trust us, which is why account management matters here as much as new business. The ramp is deliberate: expect full autonomy over the territory within 6 to 8 months, backed by milestone bonuses while the funnel builds. Your first three months will follow a structured onboarding plan with active coaching, defined milestones and hands\-on time alongside our engineers, so you are not left to work it out on your own. Capital equipment cycles are long, but we don’t starve a good engineer waiting for the first sale to close.

03\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory and accounts

* Own the Bay Area and Northern California territory across aerospace, microelectronics and consumer electronics, space and defense, automotive and EV, medical device, and industrial and civil structures
* Work inbound leads from ZEISS and our digital marketing through qualification to first meeting
* Generate the rest of your pipeline yourself: trade show and conference follow\-up, referrals, and prospecting into new groups inside accounts we already serve
* Support existing accounts and identify follow\-on system, software, and service opportunities
* Forecast territory opportunities accurately and keep management updated on a regular cadence

Technical selling and delivery

* Present and demonstrate ARAMIS, ATOS, TRITOP, and the wider ZEISS portfolio at customer test labs and trade shows
* Run standard demonstrations and basic software training independently once ramped, including specimen preparation and system setup
* Process and present measurement results, and run proof\-of\-concept engagements and ROI analyses tied to the customer's test program
* Bring in our engineering team for complex projects, multi\-day training, and service work

Deal execution

* Design and develop tailored proposals and system configurations
* Manage the full sales process from first contact through purchase order
* Maintain accurate account, contact, and opportunity records in HubSpot CRM and Odoo ERP

04\. ABOUT YOU

* 2 to 3 years of experience in technical sales, applications engineering, or hands\-on test and measurement work, in aerospace \& defense, electronics \& AR/VR hardware, automotive \& EV, robotics, biomechanics, material science or an adjacent field
* MS/BS in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering, Material Science or similar Engineering Major
* Comfortable with mechanical engineering fundamentals: strain, stress, fatigue, and structural test
* Comfortable explaining technical concepts clearly and concisely to test engineers and executives
* Hands\-on experience with test equipment or measurement instrumentation, and the confidence to run a live system demonstration in front of a customer without support
* Willing and able to generate your own pipeline: outbound calls and emails, trade show and conference follow\-up, and prospecting into adjacent groups at existing accounts
* Organized and self\-directed; this territory runs on a plan you build yourself
* Excellent computer skills including AI usage for day\-to\-day sales engineerin

jobs.description:
### **Who We Are**



Simpplr is the AI\-powered intranet for unifying the digital workplace. It brings people, trusted knowledge, apps, and agents into a coherent digital experience. Powered by a proprietary EX Knowledge Graph, Simpplr synthesizes signals and context across connected systems to deliver personalized information and actions. The platform serves as a digital hub supporting communications, engagement, employee services, and work. With low\-code extensibility and enterprise\-grade security and governance, Simpplr enables confident operation at scale. More than 1,000 organizations — including AAA, the NHS, Penske, and Moderna — trust Simpplr to keep their workforce informed, aligned, and productive. Learn more at simpplr.com.

### **The Opportunity**



We are looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our team!



At Simpplr, we know that the key to growth is a high\-performing sales team. That’s why we’re seeking a qualified sales development representative (SDR) to find and screen potential customers who could benefit from our products and services. As the first line of communication with a prospect, the ideal SDR has a strong understanding of the sales process and excels at qualifying leads, starting new relationships, and setting up sales closers for success. The SDR should be a quick learner who has strong communication skills and an ability to showcase our offerings compellingly. Every potential customer is an opportunity for boosting top\-line revenue growth, customer acquisition levels, and profitability.


### **Your Job Responsibilities**


#### **What you will be doing:**


* Efficiently respond and qualify inbound marketing leads, reaching out with urgency and contacting leads in 10 minutes or less
* Generate new business opportunities to fuel the sales pipeline
* Call, Email, and use social touches to follow up with Inbound Marketing Leads promptly
* Engage in conversation to qualify inbound marketing leads based on qualification criteria.
* Evangelize Simpplr both internally and through your inbound efforts
* Achieve monthly quotas of sales accepted opportunities and sales qualified opportunities (Stage 2 \& Stage 4\)

### **Your Skillset**


#### **What makes you a great fit for our team:**


* Have an interest in sales, a sales background, or 0\-6 months of SDR experience
* Proven track record of quota and KPI attainment
* A driven individual who thrives on success and winning
* You have demonstrated strong verbal and written communication skills including responding to inquiries both on the phone and via email
* Demonstrated strong problem\-solving skills to help decode a prospect's pain points through a short conversation
* You have been able to learn, from formalized instruction and also self\-discovery, how to best present the benefits of the product you are selling
* Ability to understand customer needs and meet those needs with a successful product sale
* Shown excellent time management skills and the ability to work in an efficient manner


Our job titles may span more than one career level. The starting base pay for this role is between $57,000 \- $65,000\. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity and benefits.



Simpplr is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or genetics.



\#LI\-HYBRID


Pay Range


$57,000 \- $65,000 USD

### **Your Voice, Unfiltered:**



We value the real you. To ensure a fair and authentic experience for everyone, we ask that you do not use AI tools (such as real\-time answer generators, transcription apps, or note\-taking bots) during your interview



Our process is designed to hear your unique story, thought process, and lived experience in real\-time. Use of unauthorized AI tools may result in disqualification, as we want to ensure every candidate is evaluated on their own individual merits. We’re excited to meet the person behind the resume!



If you need assistive technology or AI tools for accessibility (e.g., live captioning), please notify your recruiter in advance. We are committed to providing an inclusive interview experience.

  

### **Simpplr’s Hub\-Hybrid\-Remote Model:**



At Simpplr we believe that when work is good, life is better and that belief guides all we do. Including how we approach our flexible work model. Simpplr operates with a Hub\-Hybrid\-Remote model. This model is role\-based with exceptions and provides employees with the flexibility that many have told us they want.


* **Hub \-** **100% work from Simpplr office.** Role requires Simpplifier to be in the office full\-time.
* **Hybrid \-** **Hybrid work from home and office.** Role dictates the ability to work from home, plus benefit from in\-person collaboration on a regular basis.
* **Remote \- 100% remote.** Role can be done anywhere within your country of hire, as long as the requirements of the role are met.

jobs.title: Assistant Community Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**



Avanath is proud to be named one of the top property management companies that provide affordable housing for the workforce.


*Cultivating the American Dream* is the purpose that binds the Avanath team. At Avanath, every day is an opportunity to make a difference in someone's life. Whether it is helping residents call one of our communities home, providing excellence in customer service, or championing our workforce, we are committed to creating an unforgettable experience as a great place to live, work, and be.


**The Role:**This role is responsible for assisting in all operational duties of the Community Manager, including reporting, rent processing, leasing, marketing, and overseeing the community and associates in the Community Manager's absence.


***The incumbent in this role must possess a high degree of professionalism and positive engagement for our residents and the workforce.***


* **An Aptitude for Connecting \-** Must possessa strong sense for creating a sense of community, as well as the drive to go the extra mile to create a positive experience for all residents and staff. Your success and purpose are driven by the relationships that you build within your communities, including vendor partners, regulatory, and social services partnerships. This includes adopting a collaborative approach to create consistent, favorable circumstances that foster success and effectiveness for the Organization and the communities.
* **An Authentic Attitude \-** Consistently demonstrate an open and professional attitude and approach when accessing and resolving resident and staff concerns. This includes, but is not limited to, seeking resources throughout the organization via the organization's support services and senior leadership.
* **An Approach that is positive and Professional** \- Consistently demonstrate an approach of active listening and understand that your participation and support are integral to the success of Avanath, ensuring that each resident and staff member feels seen, heard, and valued as you and the staff work to resolve challenges.


**Qualifications**


* 2\+ years' experience as an Assistant Community Manager.
* LIHTC/Tax Credit Program Knowledge required.
* Equipped with excellent communication skills and an unmatched dedication to customer service.
* Solid track record of bookkeeping and rent collection.
* Thorough understanding of landlord/tenant law.
* Strong Understanding of Fair Housing Laws.
* Superior interpersonal skills: ability to get along with diverse personalities; tactful; mature, flexible.
* Resourceful and organized.
* Solid computer knowledge, Windows (Word, Excel), internet, and e\-mail.
* Working knowledge of Yardi Voyager Property Management software.


**Key Accountabilities**

\+ **Resident Relations \+ Customer Service**


* At all times, regardless, provides A\+ customer service.
* Manages and promotes resident satisfaction and retention by responding to complaints, questions, and requests in a timely manner, and taking appropriate action to resolve and address service issues.
* Functions as a resource center for residents on all things that affect and may disturb their community\-living experience and ability to make timely rent payments.
* Organizes and executes resident appreciation and retention events.
* Maintains a secure, confidential file for each resident.
* Answering phones, greeting walk\-ins, and handling foot traffic.
* Assist with leasing job duties, including touring prospective residents.


\+ **Fiduciary**


* Handles all the monies of the property. Collects, posts, and deposits rents/security deposits and other community income.
* Reviews resident files and ledger records to determine unpaid and/or late fees owed, communicates with residents regarding outstanding balances, implements procedures for collecting on delinquencies, and enforces the lease agreements.
* Assist with Monthly Projection Reporting, inspect vacancies, make\-ready apartments, and models. Inspects the property for community policy violations, needed repairs, and overall landscaping.
* Meets regularly with Community Manager and Regional Manager to discuss community performance.
* Other duties as assigned by Community Manager.


\+ **Staff Leadership**


* Maintains a service\-oriented environment by always exhibiting a professional appearance and attitude.
* Oversees property operations and staff in Community Manager's absence.
* Support Leasing Consultants in the leasing of apartments and ensure that Fair Housing guidelines are followed.
* Under the direction of the Compliance department and the Community Manager, manages compliance file maintenance, where applicable.


\+ **Adherence to Property Management Rules, Regulations, and Guidelines**


* Conduct all business in accordance with company policies and procedures, Fair Housing, *Americans with Disabilities Act,* and all other laws pertaining to the apartment industry.
* Under the direction of the Compliance department and the Community Manager, manages compliance file maintenance, where applicable.
* Follows the Company's established procedures related to evictions by following proper notice requirements, evicting residents, and representing the property as required in court hearings and eviction proceedings.


**Physical Demands \& Working Conditions**

* The incumbent in this position is classified as essential staff and is expected to report to work and adhere to all safety and business protocols.
* Frequent sitting and walking.
* Repetitive use of the computer, keyboard, mouse, and phone.
* Reading, comprehending, writing, performing calculations, and communicating verbally.
* May work in an elevated site, may walk on uneven ground.
* Occasional squatting, bending neck/waist, twisting neck/waist, pushing, and pulling.


**How Avanath Supports You**



We know that our teams are the heart of our success and growth, and we are committed to showing our appreciation.



We offer:


*

jobs.description:
Job Description:
**Executive Assistant**  

  

**Join SE Ventures and power your career!**  

  

Discover the opportunity to join an international, dynamic, and fast\-growing venture capital fund investing in early\-stage companies focused on climate change, sustainability, and industrial technology. Every day, we empower employees to achieve more and experience exciting careers.  

  

Backed by Schneider Electric and located on Sand Hill Road in Menlo Park, SE Ventures offers a collaborative, fast\-paced environment where employees are encouraged to take initiative, contribute broadly, and grow their careers.  

  

Learn more about SE Ventures:  

https://www.seventures.com/home.jsp  

  

**About the Role**  

  

The Executive Assistant will provide high\-quality administrative support to designated members of the SE Ventures leadership team while contributing to the smooth day\-to\-day operation of the Menlo Park office.  

  

This is a collaborative, hands\-on role requiring discretion, sound judgment, flexibility, and a positive, team\-first mindset. In addition to supporting designated executives, this position will partner closely with the Head of Office Operations on routine office and team needs.  

  

Responsibilities may evolve based on executive, team, event, and office needs. The successful candidate will be comfortable stepping in where reasonably needed to help maintain a professional, organized, welcoming, and well\-functioning workplace. **Key Responsibilities** **Executive Support (approximately 80% of the role)*** Manage calendars, travel arrangements, itineraries, and expense reports for designated executives.
* Coordinate meetings and appointments across multiple time zones with internal and external stakeholders.
* Facilitate effective communication between supported executives, SE Ventures team members, Schneider Electric colleagues, startup founders, investors, other venture capital firms, and external parties.
* Prepare meeting materials, organize correspondence, take notes when requested, and track follow\-up items.
* Anticipate needs, identify scheduling or logistical conflicts, and proactively recommend solutions.
* Troubleshoot urgent travel, scheduling, and technology\-related issues, particularly while senior leaders are traveling.
* Provide administrative and project\-based support as business needs arise.
* Provide essential backup administrative coverage during planned PTO, sick leave, or other absences. Coverage will focus on urgent or time\-sensitive needs, including calendar management, travel assistance, meeting coordination, and other critical support necessary to maintain business continuity.
* Coordinate appropriate handoffs before planned absences and prioritize or escalate urgent requests that arise during unplanned absences.

**Office and Team Support (approximately 20% of the role)**  

  

In partnership with the Head of Office Operations:* Monitor inventory and assist with ordering, receiving, organizing, and replenishing office, kitchen, and meeting supplies.
* Regularly stock and organize snacks, beverages, coffee, refrigerators, and pantry areas.
* Prepare and reset conference rooms and shared spaces for meetings, visitors, catering, and office events.
* Greet visitors and help provide a professional and welcoming experience for external guests, visiting executives, and team members.
* Assist with catering orders, deliveries, setup, cleanup coordination, and other meeting or event logistics.
* Help receive office deliveries and coordinate routine vendor visits.
* Communicate facilities, equipment, supply, or workplace issues to the Head of Office Operations and assist with follow\-through as needed.
* Provide coverage for essential day\-to\-day office responsibilities during the Head of Office Operations’ planned or unplanned absence.
* Support local events, offsites, internal team activities, and visits from Schneider Electric executives or other external parties.
* Take on additional reasonable administrative or office\-support responsibilities as team and business needs evolve.

**Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree or Five or more years of executive assistant, administrative, or office\-support experience; experience within venture capital, private equity, investment banking, professional services, or another client\-facing environment is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience managing executive calendars, travel, meetings, and expenses.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong proficiency with Outlook and experience managing calendars and correspondence on behalf of senior executives.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience with Coupa for procurement and Concur for travel and expenses is preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to exercise independent judgment, maintain confidentiality, and handle sensitive or critical matters appropriately.
* Proactive and resourceful, with a high degree of initiative, ownership, attention to detail, and follow\-through.
* Positive, collaborative, and team\-oriented approach, with a willingness to contribute to both executive support and hands\-on office responsibilities.
* Curiosity and a self\-motivated approach to learning new systems, processes, and skills.
* Professional, friendly, and welcoming demeanor.
* Ability to work onsite in the Menlo Park office five days per week and occasionally adjust working hours to support business, meeting, travel, or event needs.

* Present and represent the division and the Agency at project meetings. Negotiate and advocate on behalf of Parks, defending the agency’s open space goals and interests.
