jobs.description:
Administrative \& Program Coordinator

The Administrative \& Program Coordinator provides administrative, program, development, and governance support to the Executive Director and contributes to the effective day\-to\-day operation of Riverdale Senior Services (RSS). The position supports contract and grant administration, fundraising activities, Board and committee coordination, transportation services, invoice reconciliation, and general office operations. The Administrative \& Program Coordinator works with senior leadership, Board members, funders, staff, vendors, older adult members, and community partners while maintaining a high level of confidentiality and professionalism.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities, and comfortable working independently and collaboratively. Working knowledge of social media, nonprofit operations, and programs serving older adults is preferred. This position reports directly to the Executive Director.

Key Responsibilities1\. Administrative Support

* Provide administrative and organizational support to the Executive Director.
* Assist with the preparation, submission, tracking, monitoring, and compliance of contracts and grants.
* Coordinate monthly staff meetings, including scheduling, agendas, meeting materials, and summaries as requested.
* Coordinate and provide administrative support for Board and committee meetings, including scheduling, meeting invitations and reminders, preparation and distribution of agendas and materials, meeting logistics, and maintenance of meeting records. Serve as a liaison among the Executive Director, staff, Board members, and committee chairs to facilitate communication and follow\-up.
* Support the Executive Director and Deputy Director with special projects, research, correspondence, and organizational initiatives.

2\. Development \& Fundraising

* Assist with the coordination and administration of fundraising events, campaigns, and development initiatives.
* Prepare reports, summaries, and supporting materials for fundraising activities.
* Assist with grant\-related administrative requirements, deadlines, and documentation.

3\. Transportation Coordination

* Communicate with transportation providers regarding schedules, changes, cancellations, and service issues.
* Monitor transportation\-related concerns and follow up with vendors, staff, and members to resolve issues.
* Maintain transportation documentation required for contracts, grants, reporting, and compliance.
* Track transportation activity and prepare reports or summaries as requested by the Executive Director.
* Ensure transportation\-related information is handled confidentially and professionally.

4\. Office Operations \& Financial Administration

* Review and reconcile monthly invoices from contracted consultants and service providers against contracts, approved services, and supporting documentation.
* Verify invoice accuracy, identify discrepancies or missing documentation, and coordinate follow\-up with appropriate staff or vendors.

* Handle confidential information with discretion and in accordance with organizational policies.

5\. Program \& Organizational Support

* Provide administrative coordination for RSS programs and activities, including scheduling, communications, documentation, and logistics.
* Assist with coordination and communication with community partners, vendors, and other external stakeholders.
* Participate in agency\-wide initiatives, special events, and organizational projects.
* Support departments and staff with administrative and operational needs as required.
* Perform other duties as assigned in support of the mission and goals of Riverdale Senior Services.

Preferred Skills \& Qualifications

* Strong administrative, organizational, and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Experience supporting senior leadership, Boards, committees, programs, or nonprofit organizations.
* Experience coordinating transportation, scheduling, vendors, or member services preferred.
* Experience with invoice review, reconciliation, financial recordkeeping, or administrative financial processes preferred.
* Familiarity with fundraising CRM databases and basic development operations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and follow\-through.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and online scheduling and collaboration tools.
* Experience with NYC contracting and procurement systems preferred.
* Working knowledge of social media platforms and nonprofit communications preferred.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
* Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a team.
* Dependable, professional, and committed to providing high\-quality administrative and program support.
* Commitment to the mission of senior services and community\-based nonprofit work.

Salary \& Benefits

The salary range for this position is **$55,000 – $65,000 annually**, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

**Riverdale Senior Services offers a comprehensive benefits package, which includes 100% paid employee health insurance, generous paid time

jobs.company: It Takes A Village Youth Services
jobs.title: Program Coordinator – Recess Coach (Harlem)
jobs.description:
**Turn Recess Into Something Kids Look Forward To!** ⚽

Program Coordinator – Recess Coach

**Love working with kids? Enjoy sports, games, movement, and bringing positive energy wherever you go?**

ITAV is looking for energetic, dependable, and enthusiastic **Program Coordinators – Recess Coaches** to help us transform recess into a fun, safe, inclusive, and meaningful part of the school day.

This isn't a job where you simply stand on the sidelines and watch.

You'll be **leading games, getting kids moving, encouraging teamwork, helping students work through conflicts, building confidence, and creating the kind of recess experience students can't wait to be part of.**

If you love working with young people and believe play can be a powerful way to teach leadership, communication, teamwork, and confidence — **we want to meet you!**

Who We Are

**ITAV** is a sports\-based youth development organization that uses sports, fitness, structured play, and engaging activities to help young people build confidence, communication skills, leadership, accountability, and positive relationships.

We believe kids learn some of life's most important lessons while they're moving, playing, competing, communicating, and having fun.

What You'll Be Doing

As a **Program Coordinator – Recess Coach**, you'll help bring energy, structure, and FUN to the school day.

You'll:

* Lead fun, age\-appropriate sports, games, and movement activities.
* Get students excited about participating — including kids who may not usually join in.
* Encourage teamwork, communication, sportsmanship, and fair play.
* Help students build confidence and leadership skills through play.
* Help students work through disagreements and practice healthy conflict resolution.
* Create an environment where every child feels welcomed and included.
* Actively supervise students and keep activities safe, organized, and engaging.
* Adapt games and activities to support students with different abilities and needs.
* Build positive relationships with teachers, school staff, students, and the ITAV team.
* Respond appropriately to student concerns, injuries, incidents, or unexpected situations.
* Support field days, special events, after\-school activities, and other ITAV programs when needed.

You'll Be Great at This If You...

* Genuinely enjoy working with children and young people.
* Bring positive energy into a room — or onto a playground!
* Aren't afraid to jump into a game and participate.
* Can confidently lead and engage groups of children.
* Know how to be fun **and** maintain appropriate boundaries.
* Are patient, dependable, responsible, and professional.
* Communicate well with children and adults.
* Can stay calm when things don't go exactly as planned.
* Believe every child should have an opportunity to participate and feel successful.
* Enjoy being part of a team.

What We're Looking For

**Required:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Experience working with children or youth.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to lead games, activities, and groups of students.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
* Dependability and punctuality.
* Ability to work in active indoor and outdoor environments.

**Even Better If You Have:**

* Experience as a coach, camp counselor, recreation specialist, group leader, school aide, paraprofessional, or after\-school instructor.
* Experience working with students with disabilities or behavioral support needs.
* Sports, fitness, recreation, or youth development experience.
* Knowledge of positive behavior management or conflict\-resolution strategies.
* CPR or First Aid certification.

This Role Is Active!

You won't spend your day sitting behind a desk.

You'll be walking, moving, demonstrating games, setting up activities, interacting with students, and spending time indoors and outdoors.

If you enjoy an active workday, this may be a great fit.

Why Join ITAV?

Because **recess is more than free time.**

It's where kids can learn to communicate.

It's where they practice teamwork.

It's where confidence grows.

It's where new friendships happen.

And sometimes, it's where a young person discovers that they're a leader.

At ITAV, you'll have an opportunity to make those moments happen every day.

Ready to Bring the Energy?

If you're ready to **move, motivate, mentor, and make an impact**, we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply today and help ITAV create playgrounds and programs where every child has an opportunity to play, connect, grow, and thrive!**

Pay: $18\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

The Program Director serves as the primary contact between NIA and the school principal, and represents NIA to the whole school community. * Supervise all aspects of a school\-based after\-school program

* Ensure program content supports initiative goals and outcomes
* Participate in school leadership committees and PTA meetings

* Create a strong sense of community which values respect, acceptance, and high expectations

* A minimum of a Bachelors degree related to education or youth development
* A minimum of four years of relevant experience working with children in an educational setting is preferred
* At least two years experience supervising staff and managing programs is preferred
* Strong leadership, conflict\-resolution and diplomacy skills
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, ability to prioritize, meet deadlines and multitask in a fast\-paced environment
* Capacity to work independently and collaboratively
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Computer proficiency including Microsoft Word and Excel, email correspondence, and database management is required
* Familiarity with NY State Standards
* Must be available to work Monday through Friday, between the hours of 10:00 am and 6:00 pm
* Must take part in 30 hours of professional development opportunities per year and be available for some organization events outside of regular business hours

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**  

  

Tommy John is a comfort\-focused lifestyle brand committed to solving the problem people have with their clothing. Most well\-known for reimagining the fabric, fit, and function of underwear and undershirts, Tommy John has spent the past decade making the online and in\-store shopping experience more comfortable. We are constantly on a mission to add smart, innovative and fun\-loving team members, and we are looking for a Site Merchandising Coordinator to join our New York based headquarters.
  

  

**POSITION OVERVIEW**  

  

Reporting to the Site Merchandising Manager, this role is responsible for the implementation of the site merchandising strategy and direction to translate the product assortment online through a unified search and browse experience. The primary focus of this role will be executing all product set up processes, promotional messaging/markdown updates, and visual merchandising across all pages while balancing business objectives and broader consumer trends to increase conversion and sales. This person should be thoughtful and thorough in reviewing merchandising business opportunities and steering cross\-functional teams to united objectives and should have a passion for product and best\-in\-class digital consumer experiences.  

  

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES*** Execution of product set up process with precision \& attention to each detail (SKU detail, price, images, copy description, size charts, inventory, SEO description, facet values, swatch, etc.)
* Partner with Site Merchandising for all content updates online across homepage, landing pages, and PLPs for new seasonal assortments and campaign launches
* Execute Navigation and Category page creations to support newness and consumer shopping trends
* Ensure product readiness (PDP's, inventory, copy and image, metadata) for product launches
* Collaborate with Product Buying and Merchandising teams to identify and forecast consumer trends to help support upcoming campaign and product feature strategies
* Support in managing consistent master feed data and identify any inefficiencies/improvements within online platform for the product catalog, filters, feeds, and navigation
* Support on PLP sequencing of all trafficked pages on site based on key learnings, merchandising strategies, and personalized browsing experiences
* Coordinate and execute linking strategy across the site (Navigation, Footer, Filters, etc.)
* Execute routine site maintenance by inspecting all pages, products, navigation items, and key areas of the site on a regular basis to ensure accuracy and ease of use
* Analyze site metrics, KPIs and customer feedback to improve product placements and report findings on a weekly basis and as needed
* Conduct competitive analysis to ensure tommyjohn.com is staying up to date with industry trends

**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS, \& EXPERIENCE*** Bachelor’s Degree or relevant experience within digital merchandising required
* 1\-3 years’ experience in product setup and merchandising for online platforms (Shopify a plus)
	+ Experience managing virtual packs and bundles a plus
* Analytical \& data\-driven mindset with familiarity in Excel and Google Sheets
* Experience in using \& managing visual merchandising/internal search tools
* Strong project \& process management skills with attention to detail
* Great organizational skills; ability to prioritize and multitask
* Great communications skills, both verbal and written for both internal team members, external partners, and translating information for leadership
* Passion for eCommerce \& improving the customer experience
* Demonstrated alignment with TJ core values: *Humble, Adaptable, Mindful, GSD 2\.0, \& Curious*
* Ability to be on\-site in our HQ Office in Lower Manhattan 2\-3 days per week

**Salary Range:** $70,000 \- $75,000

Ability to be seated for long periods of time.

This role is required to work 35\-40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

This position is full\-time, non\-exempt with a salary of $75,254 and includes full benefits (medical, dental, vision, life insurance, long\-term disability, incentive savings plan, paid time off, Public Service Loan Forgiveness, and potential for parental leave for full\-time regular employees who have been employed with GrowNYC for 175 day

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad\-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners \- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.


This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically\-acclaimed, industry\-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

**SiriusXM** is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising\-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad\-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross\-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

**How you’ll make an impact:**


The Marketing Specialist, Aviation \& Marine Services, plays a key role in owning and executing defined marketing initiatives that drive brand awareness, engagement, and subscriber growth for SiriusXM’s Aviation and Marine lines of business. This role combines creativity with analytical rigor to execute marketing initiatives, coordinate partnerships, and evaluate campaign performance within established processes and guidelines. The Marketing Specialist supports a wide range of activities from social media management to video production, digital campaigns, event marketing, and more.

**What you’ll do:**

* Develop and manage social media content calendars for SiriusXM Aviation and Marine brands across Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.
* Schedule and publish content while monitoring engagement, responding to comments, refining strategies based on analytics, and determining appropriate routine adjustments within established marketing guidelines.
* Keep up to date on current social media practices to identify new ideas and content that will increase engagement with our target audiences.
* Assist in filming marketing videos, including setup, interviews, and capturing b\-roll.
* Collaborate on creative assets such as emails, brochures, digital and print ads, and podcasts.
* Support website updates and coordinate with SiriusXM’s .com team and external vendors.
* Conduct monthly analysis and reporting for organic and paid search, digital advertising, social media, and email marketing; evaluate performance across channels, identify trends, and recommend actions based on multiple data points.
* Manage the production, updates, and ordering of printed materials and merchandise.
* Assist with communications with Aviation \& Marine influencers and brand ambassadors, including reviewing annual contracts.

Loro Piana is an Italian luxury Maison founded in 1924, known for creating the finest quality textiles, ready\-to\-wear collections, accessories, and bespoke garments. We are seeking a Seasonal Operations Specialist to join our team at Loro Piana. The Operations Specialist plays a pivotal role in the overall success of the business by supporting all operational and inventory\-related activities. You will be responsible for managing incoming and outgoing shipments, replenishing products on the sales floor, and organizing inventory to maximize efficiency. You will collaborate with all members of the team to ensure that stockroom conditions align with Loro Piana standards, contributing to seamless store operations.

* Optimize inventory flow and streamline operational processes while handling the accurate processing of shipments and transfers.

Provide the sales team with detailed updates regarding inventory availability to support the sales process and enhance sales performance.  
* 
### **Profile**

Skills and Abilities Required


* 3\+ years of operational and inventory experience, preferably in a luxury retail environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, SAP, and other digital tools.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong knowledge of operations and inventory control.
* Ability to lift and move objects up to 40 pounds.
### **Additional information**

What we offer


At Loro Piana, we believe in fostering a supportive and rewarding work environment that values our employees' well\-being and growth. We offer a comprehensive range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage, fertility support, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, 401K match, and Headspace mental health support. We strive to create a culture of inclusion where everyone has a sense of belonging. ***LORO PIANA***
**MAISON**

Originally from Trivero in northern Italy, the Loro Piana family began trading wool in the early 1800s. In 1924, Pietro Loro Piana founded Ing. Loro Piana \& C., the current company. jobs.title: Research Coordinator – Women’s Brain Health Research
jobs.description:
In this role, the successful candidate will independently coordinate and manage the day\-to\-day conduct of an NIH\-funded research study on **women’s brain health** (RF1AG098531\) conducted at the NYU Grossman School of Medicine. The Research Coordinator exercises independent judgment and discretion in managing study operations, resolving protocol and regulatory issues, determining participant eligibility, and analyzing study data — serving as the primary point of accountability for the study’s day\-to\-day scientific and operational integrity, under the general direction of the Principal Investigators.

  

  

  

### **Project**

  

  

This NIH\-funded project, led by Drs. Erika Raven and Jelle Veraart, focuses on improving women’s brain health by identifying why the menopause transition may increase the risk of cognitive decline and Alzheimer’s disease. Using longitudinal neuroimaging, plasma proteomics, and detailed clinical assessments of a prospective cohort, the study examines how hormonal changes and menopausal hormone therapy influence brain aging and cognitive outcomes. The goal is to define sex\-specific biomarkers and risk profiles that support earlier detection, more precise prevention, and clinically meaningful strategies to protect women’s health across midlife and aging.


### **Job Responsibilities**


**Study Coordination \& Regulatory Compliance**
* Independently manage the day\-to\-day operations of the study, exercising judgment to resolve protocol deviations, scheduling conflicts, and other non\-routine issues as they arise, escalating to the PIs only when appropriate
* Interpret and apply IRB and sponsor requirements; prepare, submit, and track continuing reviews, amendments, and reportable events, determining the appropriate course of action for ambiguous or non\-routine regulatory situations

**Participant Recruitment, Screening \& Eligibility Determination**
* Independently review medical records and screening data against complex study eligibility criteria; exercise judgment on borderline or ambiguous cases and make enrollment recommendations to the Principal Investigators
* Lead the informed consent process, ensuring participants understand study procedures, risks, and rights; manage enrollment, scheduling, and long\-term follow\-up of a prospective cohort

**Data Collection \& Quality Oversight**
* Coordinate and, where applicable, assist with MRI data collection, cognitive testing, and survey administration; select and adapt procedures to participant\-specific circumstances (e.g., menopause status, scheduling constraints) within study guidelines
* Oversee blood sample collection, storage, and shipping logistics for the plasma proteomics component of the study, ensuring compliance with protocol and chain\-of\-custody requirements

**Data Analysis, Reporting \& Team Liaison**
* Consolidate and analyze longitudinal clinical, imaging, and biomarker data; identify trends and data quality issues, and prepare summaries and recommendations that inform manuscript development and study reporting
* Serve as the primary liaison between the PIs, study team members, core facilities, and external collaborators, exercising discretion in coordinating cross\-functional study activities
### **Required Qualifications**


Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related discipline is required, along with a minimum of 2 years of clinical or human subjects research experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Must demonstrate the ability to exercise independent judgment and discretion in coordinating study operations, resolving non\-routine issues, and interfacing with participants, investigators, and regulatory bodies with minimal supervision. Effective oral and written communication and interpersonal skills, along with strong time management, organizational, and analytical skills, are required.
### **Preferred Qualifications**


Knowledge of basic medical terminology is preferred. Prior experience independently coordinating research protocols, and working with EPIC and REDCap, is preferred. Experience working in an academic medical center environment, and prior experience training or guiding junior research staff, is also preferred.

Join us and experience the extensive resources and services designed to enhance your overall quality of life for you and your family.

jobs.description:
The DERMS Operations Specialist plays a crucial role in the development and implementation of the Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS). This newly created position offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of innovation, laying the groundwork for the expansion of energy management within the distribution system. The DERMS Operations Specialist is responsible for the real\-time and near\-real\-time operational integration of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) on the electric distribution system. This role ensures DERs are operated safely, reliably, and in compliance with grid constraints, using DERMS and related advanced distribution applications. The specialist serves as a technical bridge between distribution system operators, planning, IT/OT systems, and DER programs.


Currently, DERMS is in Phase I of implementation, focusing on visibility of the distribution system. During this stage, the DERMS Operations Specialist will maintain system awareness, monitor distributed resources, and evaluate load and generation forecasts. As the program prepares for Phase II, which includes system optimization and dispatch, the DERMS Operations Specialist will contribute to the development of user interfaces, tools, and processes necessary for seamless and reliable DERMS operations. As new distributed resources are integrated, the specialist will ensure communication paths are established for real\-time monitoring and dispatch.


This role will initially follow a hybrid work schedule, with four days per week, Monday through Thursday, at the office located at 241 Ralph McGill.

jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**


Thank you for your interest in Mueller Water Products, Inc.


For more than 165 years, Mueller Water Products, Inc. has been building the future of water infrastructure. From lifesaving fire protection to data intelligence, we are committed to developing products and solutions that help cities and utilities deliver clean, safe drinking water to hundreds of millions of people across North America.


Our purpose is to connect communities to water, life’s most essential resource, with exceptional, people solutions and products. Behind that purpose is a dedicated team, united by our shared values of respect, integrity, trust, inclusion and safety. With a vision to be the leader in water infrastructure solutions—solving challenges, enriching lives and safeguarding the future—we are making a positive impact that will last for generations.


By joining Mueller, you become part of a dynamic team dedicated to excellence and innovation, working collaboratively to achieve meaningful results. We champion our people because when they succeed, our communities thrive. We invite you to learn more about career opportunities with us and consider submitting your application.


Executive Assistant**Essential Duties:**

* Support and assists 3 executive level staff members, in a fast\-paced environment, by providing a broad range of administrative support, as well as working with and providing back\-up support to other administrative resources across the Company
* Maintain and regularly update HR organizational charts, leadership team structures, and talent planning materials, ensuring accuracy and timely distribution for executive and board\-level reviews. Updates and guidance to be provided by CHRO and HR leadership team.
* Prepare, consolidate, and distribute recurring HR reports, dashboards, presentations, and workforce\-related metrics for the CHRO, HR Leadership Team, and senior executives. These reports are already designed by HR leadership and generally this requires report consolidation and pulling reports from existing data sets.
* Coordinate and manage HR Leadership Team meetings, HR staff meetings, and strategic planning sessions, including agenda development, meeting logistics, materials preparation, action item tracking, and follow\-up.
* Owns calendar management by planning and scheduling meetings, conferences, teleconferences, travel, and reservations for various activities and events, including catering
* Prepare, review and submit expense reports, following Company policies and procedures
* Develops and maintains good relationships with members of the executive team and other internal staff, seeks to understand and anticipate needs to maximize efficiency of the leaders
* Prepares, organizes and maintains information electronically and hard copy as needed, examples include documents and contracts, vendor information and payments, and internal and external correspondence
* Prepares professional\-quality presentations and reports for internal and external audiences, including the company’s executive leadership team
* Prepares outgoing correspondence such as mail, e\-mail, memos, letters and faxes
* Implements and maintains filing systems; electronic and hard copy if needed
* Manages special projects as needed and other duties as assigned

**Skills, Knowledge, Experience Abilities:**

* Minimum of 5 years of administrative support experience, preferably with 2\-3 years providing administrative support to senior level and/or C\-suite executives
* Experience providing administrative support in a publicly traded company preferred
* BA/BS, or equivalent education, highly desired
* Must possess high level of computer literacy, including strong Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, One Drive/SharePoint, Teams, etc.) skills
* Experience with web\-based systems such as Concur, or related T\&E system, for business travel \& expense is strongly desired
* Experience with expense report management for self and others. Must be comfortable with numerical/analytical work
* Experience with project management and accounting tools preferred (Asasa, Tungsten, JDE, etc.)

**Traits and Competencies:**

* Proactively and readily assumes responsibility to carry out assignments in a proficient and professional manner and ensures follow\-through and follow\-up
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously and independently, as well as working collaboratively with others
* Must possess excellent communication skills, both oral and written, and have excellent telephone, video conference and interpersonal skills
* Ability to maintain confidential and highly sensitive information and exercise discretion in dealing with others
* Must be detail oriented, organized, have excellent time\-management skills and be customer service focused
* Exhibits strong work ethic, takes initiative and can ‘read the room’ and adjust to the needs of the customer
* Eager to learn new skills, chip in and assist where needed, while recognizing and balancing priorities


**Other Compensation \& Benefits:**


Mueller offers an excellent salary and benefits package. Current benefit offerings include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan with 5% Company match, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), short\-term and long\-term disability benefits, vacation, 100% paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement program, student debt retirement matching, well\-being program, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company\-provided life insurance, supplemental insurance at group rates, and more.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Syndigo gets great products chosen. Every choice in commerce, whether by a shopper, a search engine, a marketplace, or an AI assistant, is made on product data, and our software makes that data complete and trusted and moves it across the industry's largest two\-sided commerce network: 15,000\+ brands and 3,500\+ retailers. Companies like AutoZone, Colgate\-Palmolive, Dole International, Unilever, and Walgreens trust Syndigo to get their products chosen. Learn more at www.syndigo.com.

**\*\*This is a hybrid position that requires 2 days per week in office at our Chicago location\*\***



The **Project Coordinator** supports the delivery of product content and data across recipient programs. This role manages workflows, monitors progress, maintains accurate program information, and helps resolve day\-to\-day issues that may affect content delivery or publication outcomes.



Working closely with Program Management, Customer Success, Operations, Product, Engineering, suppliers, and other stakeholders, the Project Coordinator provides hands\-on operational support for strategic programs. The role is well suited for someone who is highly organized, detail oriented, comfortable working with data, and motivated to improve the customer and recipient experience.


**HOW WE'LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY**


* Coordinate day\-to\-day activities, workflows, milestones, and deliverables across assigned recipient and retailer programs.
* Support strategic programs by monitoring product content as it moves through Syndigo workflows and identifying rejected, stalled, incomplete, or underperforming items.
* Partner with Program Managers, Customer Success Managers, Operations, Product, Engineering, suppliers, brands, and other stakeholders to help remove blockers and keep work progressing.
* Support Mandarin\-speaking suppliers and vendors participating in import vendor programs through clear business communication, onboarding, training, and ongoing operational coordination.
* Prepare and maintain weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reports for recipient programs.
* Research and respond to customer and stakeholder requests in a timely manner, ensuring appropriate follow\-through and escalation when needed.
* Review data and program outputs for completeness, accuracy, and quality in accordance with documented requirements.
* Communicate program status, risks, delays, and dependencies clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
* Assist with additional operational, reporting, documentation, and program coordination tasks based on business priorities.


**WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU**


* 1 to 3 years of experience in project coordination, operations, customer success, program support, business analysis, or a related client\-facing role
* Experience in a software\-as\-a\-service, retail, e\-commerce, product content, data management, or syndication environment preferred
* Professional working proficiency in Mandarin Chinese and English, with the ability to support business conversations, onboarding, and training for Mandarin\-speaking program participants
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with customers, suppliers, and cross\-functional teams
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel and reporting tools
* Experience with Jira, SharePoint, or similar operational tools is a plus
* Ability to work independently after training while remaining collaborative, responsive, and accountable for follow\-through
* Comfortable learning new software, workflows, and data processes

**Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion**
----------------------------------



To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating. Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it's how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful!



All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!


**GDPR/CCPA**



Syndigo, to process applications, holds onto data for a "reasonable time" after applications are submitted. This data is stored for Syndigo's internal use by HR/Recruiting Staff only. Verified requests for data deletion and exports will be completed upon request.


**Syndigo Job Applicant Privacy Notice**



At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: MSFT AI Business Solutions Project Coordinator Intern
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.


As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.


Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.


As a **MSFT AI Business Solutions** **Project Coordinator professional** in **Crowe’s Consulting Practice**, your role will be focused on helping clients resolve business needs by assisting in managing the project scope with customers, providing project leadership updates on progress, aligning direction of Crowe and customer team members with tasks for implementing complex business and technology solutions. At Crowe, we empower you to take risks, to challenge yourself in specialized areas of consulting \& technology, and to generate solutions that impact the firm and your professional growth. Crowe cultivates a creative company culture where you will have the opportunity to share your ideas and knowledge with clients from your very first day with the firm. The Project Coordinator is the central hub to manage all aspects of delivery to our clients. This is a lead\-in role for those individuals growing into a project manager career path.


You will work with clients in the manufacturing and distribution industry to help transform their business requirements into a state\-of\-the\-art cloud solution that will enable their organization to exploit new opportunities, engage better with their customers and compete globally in the dynamic “Cloud\-First” era. New hires will assist in project management activities to enable successful project outcomes by facilitating client communication, gathering business requirements, maintaining project scope, and removing project barriers. You will be expected to lead team\-building events and develop internal team and customer relationships.


**Skills and Requirements:**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and deliver effective solutions
* Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to simplify and explain complex concepts to diverse stakeholders
* Collaborative mindset with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively across teams, functions, and geographies
* Adaptable and flexible, with the ability to manage shifting priorities in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* Eagerness to learn new technologies and a commitment to continuous skill development
* Willingness to travel as needed 60% or more annually based on client or project requirements

**Education:**


We’re looking for college seniors or graduate students graduating within the next year who are pursuing degrees in **Business, Management, or a related field**, and are eager to launch a career in a fast\-paced, client\-focused environment. Preferred areas of study include:

* Business Administration
* Accounting
* Finance
* Operations Management
* Supply Chain
* Management
* Information Technology or Information Systems
* Or a comparable major


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.


In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.


The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $27\.00 \- $42\.00 per hour. **Our Benefits:**

jobs.description:
WEC Business Services LLC, a subsidiary of WEC Energy Group, is seeking a Customer Program Associate in our Chicago, Illinois location. This position is currently hybrid with potential for 50% travel.

 **About Us**

  

WEC Energy Group is one of the nation’s largest electric generation and distribution and natural gas delivery holding companies serving 4\.7 million customers across the Midwest. We are committed to providing clean, reliable, and affordable energy in an environmentally sustainable manner. Customers are the heart of our business, and we work every day to help grow and support communities where we provide vital energy services.

  

As a Fortune 500 company, we value and develop our employees who are making a difference in a mission that matters. We don’t just offer a job; we provide fulfilling careers where safety and well\-being are paramount. Join our team and experience first\-hand our commitment to your success. We offer competitive pay and benefits to recognize your hard work and dedication.

  

If you’re talented, energetic and ready for a career with a future, we want you on our team. We are powered by a diverse and inclusive workforce fueled by the pride in what we do. If you're driven by the passion to change lives, this is the place for you.


**Job Summary**
---------------

  

The Customer Program Associate supports the development and implementation of comprehensive engagement strategies and activities to support the company’s natural gas energy efficiency goals. This role will support the residential and business programs and will involve close collaboration with internal and external teams to ensure program success including goals, budget and customer satisfaction. The Customer Program Associate brings a high level of professionalism, exceptional communication skills, and strong organizational abilities, with a proven talent for managing details and driving successful outcomes.

  

Successful candidates will embrace the opportunity to learn on the job, develop expertise in energy efficiency programs, and contribute to meaningful work that supports a clean energy future.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

  

* Support the planning, coordination, and execution of customer energy efficiency programs and related initiatives, including support for multiple program offerings and customer engagement activities
* Lead the Trade Ally (program partner contractors) development effort, with a focus on strengthening and expanding the network of participating contractors
* Build, maintain and enhance relationships with customers, trade allies, implementation contractors, and utility stakeholders to ensure successful program delivery and a positive customer experience
* Conduct field visits, customer site visits, trade ally meetings to gain firsthand insight into program delivery, customer interactions, and operational challenges
* Support outreach efforts to customers and trade allies to promote program participation and engagement
* Identify opportunities for program improvements and support implementation efforts
* Support the development, tracking and reporting of program metrics
* Lead daily customer experience support for assigned programs and initiatives, including management of customer inquiries and issue resolution
* Plan and implement customer satisfaction surveys and reports
* Assists with departmental ad hoc projects as needed
**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

  

* Bachelors degree required. Preferred majors: Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, Public Policy, Social Sciences, or related discipline
* Entry level with some relevant experience preferred
**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

  

* Experience in program coordination, project management, customer\-facing operations, account management, energy efficiency, utilities, or a related field
* Strong project management, analysis, decision making and problem\-solving skills
* Knowledge of or interest in learning the utility and energy efficiency industries. Experience supporting program implementation, operations, customer engagement, or project coordination is preferred
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (both written and verbal)
* Experience working with customers, contractors, vendors, external partners, or other stakeholders in a customer service, program support, project coordination, or business operations capacity
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain productive relationships with customers, contractors, trade allies, and internal team members
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to prioritize, pay attention to detail and manage multiple tasks
* Proficient in standard office software (MS PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, Excel, etc.)
* Ability to analyze information, identify trends and opportunities, and make recommendations to improve program performance and customer experience
* Demonstrated ability to learn new industries, programs, processes, and technologies quickly

**End Date:** 09/25/2026

 **Pay Range Minimum**: $68,436\.68

**Pay Range Maximum**: $102,655\.28

  

The pay range reflects the minimum and maximum for the position at the time of posting and may be modified in the future. jobs.title: Mentoring Program Coordinator - Leaders of Tomorrow
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Join our dynamic team as a Mentoring Program Coordinator for the Leaders of Tomorrow initiative! In this role, you will be at the forefront of empowering youth and fostering community engagement through innovative mentoring programs. Your energy, leadership, and organizational skills will drive the success by creating meaningful connections that inspire growth and development. This position offers an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact while honing your project management and community engagement expertise.

This role is ideal for motivated individuals passionate about leadership development and community service. If you thrive in fast paced environments where your proactive approach can foster meaningful change apply today to become a vital part of our mission to empower tomorrow’s leaders!

**POSITION SUMMARY** 

Under the supervision of the Director of Youth Services, the **Leaders of Tomorrow School\-Based Group Mentoring Program Coordinator** will oversee all programmatic and administrative aspects of group mentoring services at Shields Middle School. The LOT Mentoring Program Coordinator is responsible for working collaboratively with school staff to recruit prospective youth participants, coordinate scheduling of group sessions, oversee the implementation of the group curriculum, supervise the LOT Mentor to ensure high quality service delivery, and provide direct group mentoring services to youth participants. The Program Coordinator should be passionate about supporting youth development and working collaboratively with students, families, and school staff to help middle school youth attain holistic well\-being.

This is a year\-round position and requires a flexible work schedule that accommodates students and their families.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Oversee recruitment of eligible group mentoring participants
* Work with school staff to schedule group mentoring sessions without disrupting instruction
* Develop and implement individualized strategies to sustain consistent youth engagement in group mentoring services over time, in collaboration with school staff, the LOT Mentor, and parents or guardians as appropriate
* Oversee the implementation of BPNC’s evidence\-informed group mentoring curriculum
* Provide ongoing individual supervision to the LOT Mentor based at Chicago Public School located on the southwest side of Chicago, in order to ensure high quality service delivery
* Deliver group mentoring services to youth participants
* Participate in continuous improvement sessions with the City of Chicago Department of Family and Support Services to review data, monitor progress, and assess youth outcomes
* In consultation with the LOT mentor and mentees, plan and facilitate quarterly, youth\-led outings that are developmentally appropriate and focus on areas of support identified by the youth themselves
* Collaborate with external partners to connect youth to additional services and resources as needed
* Maintain a positive work atmosphere by behaving and communicating in an appropriate and respectful manner with supervisees, students, school, agency staff, and parents
* Participate in regular staff meetings, staff trainings, supervisory sessions and other duties as assigned by the supervisor
* Adhere to agency policy, procedures and the professional code of ethics
* Perform other related duties as assigned

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor's degree required
* At least 1 year of supervisory experience preferred
* At least 2 years of experience providing mentoring support to school age children and adolescents
* Must be over 24 years old
* Required bilingual in Spanish
* Sensitive to needs of low\-income/immigrant youth and their families
* Must be highly organized, self\-motivated and comfortable working independently
* Ability to travel between different work sites
* Ability to pass a routine background check as well as a Chicago Public Schools background check

Pay: $60,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Are you over 24 years old?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Supervising: 1 year (Required)
* Mentoring: 2 years (Preferred)

Language:

* English and Spanish (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: TLC Performance Enablement Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary and Responsibilities**  

As our TLC Performance Enablement Coordinator, you will play a critical role in supporting the delivery of our enterprise performance enablement strategy by managing the operational cadence of annual and ongoing performance processes. You will serve as a key point of contact for HR partners, leaders, and team members, ensuring that our performance management initiatives are executed with precision, consistency, and a focus on providing a seamless user experience across the entire organization.  

Every day you will manage the administrative and project\-based workflows that keep our performance programs running smoothly, including maintaining project timelines, updating process documentation, and coordinating system communications. You will partner closely with Information Technology, HR, and external vendors to track program milestones, facilitate system testing, and resolve operational issues. By maintaining a robust library of knowledge articles, templates, and resources, you will empower our workforce to engage effectively with our performance management systems and processes.  

To be successful in this role, you will leverage your strong organizational skills and collaborative mindset to drive continuous improvement across our performance enablement framework. You will utilize data\-driven reporting and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for enhancement, ensuring our practices remain compliant, efficient, and aligned with organizational goals. Your ability to navigate complex, matrixed environments—ideally within a large healthcare setting—will be essential as you provide guidance, training, and support to stakeholders to drive consistent adoption of performance excellence.* Coordinate annual performance cycles, goal management processes, and ongoing performance discussions across the enterprise.
* Manage operational documentation, project plans, and communication materials to ensure program delivery excellence.
* Provide high\-level administrative support for performance systems, including system testing, vendor coordination, and issue resolution.
* Develop and maintain user resources, including job aids, templates, and knowledge articles to support leaders and HR partners.
* Monitor program metrics and generate dashboards to track effectiveness and identify opportunities for process improvement.
* Support leader enablement by coordinating training sessions and fostering consistent adoption of performance management best practices.

**Job Requirements****Required*** Education \- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Healthcare Administration, or a related field required.
* One to Three (1\-3\) years of experience in: coordinating enterprise programs, projects, or operational processes; supporting HR systems, enterprise technology platforms, or business process administration; developing communications, training materials, reports, or documentation.
* Must have strong organizational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

**Preferred*** Change management
* Continuous improvement


Where You'll Work  

Inspired by faith. Driven by innovation. Powered by humankindness. CommonSpirit Health is building a healthier future for all through its integrated health services. As one of the nation’s largest nonprofit Catholic healthcare organizations, CommonSpirit Health delivers more than 20 million patient encounters annually through more than 2,300 clinics, care sites and 137 hospital\-based locations, in addition to its home\-based services and virtual care offerings. CommonSpirit has more than 157,000 employees, 45,000 nurses and 25,000 physicians and advanced practice providers across 24 states and contributes more than $4\.2 billion annually in charity care, community benefits and unreimbursed government programs. Together with our patients, physicians, partners, and communities, we are creating a more just, equitable, and innovative healthcare delivery system. **Pay Range**

--------------------

**JOB OVERVIEW**At Wheels, we’re shaping the future of mobility by delivering experiences our customers love and moving businesses forward through passionate people and creative solutions. The Account Manager plays a vital role in that mission, serving as the central point of connection between our clients and our internal teams to ensure a seamless, high\-impact experience every step of the way.

  

This is a highly visible, relationship\-driven role responsible for the day\-to\-day management of a diverse portfolio of clients. You’ll work closely with Client Management and key operational areas to ensure 100% client retention, acting as a trusted advocate who executes transactions, manages escalations, and brings forward strategic ideas that drive client success. From leading action registers and planning initiatives to participating in meetings, you’ll represent the client voice across our business. Working in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, success in this role requires strong initiative, disciplined execution, and the ability to manage competing priorities with clarity and care. You’ll collaborate daily with leaders, employees, customers, and suppliers across all levels of the organization, building the relationships and trust that drive meaningful outcomes and lasting client partnerships.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES \- ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**
* Manage a diverse portfolio of Clients
* Process, oversee and seek resolution on all Client operational requests
* Set up, facilitate Client Action register calls, and ensure items are progressing to completion
* Establish yourself as a knowledgeable resource in products, services, and communications to our clients

jobs.description:
**About HUB**


In a rapidly changing world, HUB advises businesses and individuals on how to prepare for the unexpected. As one of the world’s largest insurance brokers, our focus is dedicated to providing our customers with the peace of mind that what matters most will be protected — through unrelenting advocacy and tailored insurance solutions that put our clients in control. Our growing team of professionals across North America represents a broad, deep and one\-of\-a kind aggregation of entrepreneurs and leaders recognized for their excellence throughout the insurance community.

**Why Choose HUB?**


Throughout our network of more than 700 HUB offices in North America, we offer a competitive, exciting and friendly work environment that strategically positions our employees for longevity and success. At HUB, we believe in investing in the future of our employees, and provide continuous opportunities for growth and development. Our entrepreneurial culture fosters an environment that empowers our people to make the best decisions for our customers and organization, focusing on expanding the industry knowledge of our insurance professionals to better serve our valued clients. We are committed to providing you with competitive and flexible benefits options that are rooted in your current needs, yet evolves as your needs change over time. Join us in taking the first step toward creating a future that combines a diverse, challenging work environment with financial security and career satisfaction.

**We are the perfect fit if you:**

* are seeking a progressive work environment at a rapidly growing organization
* have a desire to help others protect their future
* have an entrepreneurial spirit and are challenged by the opportunity to grow the business
* are focused on learning and development to enhance your industry knowledge and expertise
* are a self\-starter willing to invest time and energy to learn the technical aspects of our business
* believe in integrity and building success by developing relationships with others

**Position Summary**


This role requires an individual who is professional and who displays the drive, determination, and self\-motivation to build a business. Specifically, the responsibilities of the Account Manager will be to service and maintain existing accounts, while identifying opportunities for increasing business.

**Job Duties:**

* Manages a book of Middle Market (annual revenue per account generally greater than $5,000\) insurance business, while acting with a high degree of independent discretion, autonomy and decision\-making.
* Provides professional and courteous service to clients, carrier representatives, business partners, and HUB colleagues, resulting in a rate of account retention that meets or exceeds expectations.
* Interfacing with Account Executives, provides a high level of support to Producers in obtaining, maintaining, and expanding business.
* Identifies opportunities for cross\-sell and up\-sell of HUB products and services when appropriate for the clients’ needs.
* Works independently as well as cooperatively and professionally with Producers and Account Executives to deliver all HUB services to assigned clients throughout the policy cycle. This includes but is not limited to stewardship reports, risk control services, preparation of coverage outlines/proposals, claims reviews, and marketing of emergent and renewal coverage requests.
* Actively participates with account team members in monthly “Top Account” meetings.
* Either directly or cooperatively with HUB colleagues, produces binders, certificates, endorsements and other policy related documents in a timely manner while verifying their accuracy.
* Acquires understanding of clients’ insurance objectives and critically analyzes and compares insurance plans to determine suitability. Stays abreast of changes in the insurance industry and other external conditions that may impact clients. Makes appropriate recommendations to clients in response to those changes, independent of manager approval.
* Acts as liaison between clients and insurance carriers to resolve escalated complex service issues that require policy interpretation and experience\-based judgment to resolve. May also negotiate with underwriters and carriers. Troubleshoots claims and billing issues.
* Manages, organizes, and conducts client meetings when necessary.
* Appropriately documents transactions with clients and carrier representatives, and updates broker management systems as required. Ensures the accuracy of data in those systems.
* Supports, mentors and trains lower\-level colleagues, as necessary.
* Attends industry related continuing education training and courses.

**Qualifications:**

* Life, Accident and Health Insurance License required
* Bachelor's degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, certifications, training, and relevant professional experience that demonstrates the knowledge, skills, and abilities required for success in the role.
* 2\-5 years of related experience working as an Account Manager or Account Representative in the employee benefit arena
* Strong ability to listen, discern, and prioritize with clients, colleagues and carrier representatives based on a thorough understanding of relevant issues.
* Comprehend and follow instructions; maintain attention and concentration for necessary periods; carry out instructions (written, oral or diagrammatic); adapt to situations requiring the precise attainment of set limits, tolerances, or standards; respond appropriately to changes in the work setting.
* Above average written and oral communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Ability to utilize and be proficient in broker management systems

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


This team is focused on increasing adoption of Amazon Web Services by developing strategic accounts within the Fortune 1000\. This role calls for someone with business savvy and the technical background to help establish Amazon as a key technology platform provider. The ideal candidate brings a genuine passion for the intersection of Travel \& Hospitality with Technology.  

  

As an Enterprise Account Manager, you will have the exciting opportunity to help drive the growth and shape the future of an emerging technology. Your responsibilities will include driving revenue, adoption, and market penetration in enterprise accounts. We're looking for someone who possesses both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive engagement at the CXO level as well as with software developers and IT architects. The right person for this role is a self\-starter who is prepared to develop and execute against a territory coverage plan and consistently deliver on quarterly revenue targets.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Serve as a member of a three (3\) seller team structure, with one Principal Account Manager account lead, one Senior Account Manager, and one Account Manager
* Drive revenue and market share in a defined territory or industry vertical
* Meet or exceed quarterly revenue targets
* Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan
* Create \& articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services
* Accelerate customer adoption
* Maintain a robust sales pipeline
* Work with partners to extend reach \& drive adoption
* Manage contract negotiations
* Develop long\-term strategic relationships with key accounts
* Have responsibility for a specific portion of the customers portfolio, workloads, and projects
* Ensure customer satisfaction
* Expect moderate travel

  

A day in the life  

* Operate as a collaborative team member in a multi\-seller cross\-functional team
* Set the standard for account management practices
* Provide input into the creation of team goals
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks to one team strategy and outcomes
* Communicate effectively and collaboratively as part of multi\-seller team with up to 20 matrixed team members

  

  

  

About the team  

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all  

sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by  

providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and unwavering support. We dive deep  

to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that  

accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most  

adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.  

  

About AWS  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

------------------------

* 5\+ years of technology sales experience
* Experience in direct customer engagement, with a focus on support to senior executives (Vice President and C\-level)
* Experience with large scale IT/digital/business transformation or migration programs in a customer facing role

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience with AWS or cloud technologies

jobs.description:
**About Arcwood**
Every advancement—from the products we use to the medicines and technologies we depend on—creates waste that must be handled responsibly. For more than 50 years, Arcwood Environmental has helped organizations across the United States ***manage the byproducts of progress*** safely and thoughtfully. With deep expertise and innovative waste management technology across a growing nationwide footprint, Arcwood protects people, communities, and the environment through work that often happens behind the scenes. **Our Values**
We move forward together, one team with a shared purpose, counting on each other every day. Our core values demonstrate how we work together to deliver value for our customers, putting them at the center of all we do:
* **Lead with Safety:** We uphold the highest safety and compliance standards to protect our teams, our customers and the communities that count on us.
* **Solve Problems Creatively:** We push for better – advancing technologies, processes, and ideas that protect human health and the environment.
* **Own It Together:** We are individually and collectively accountable for our work and our impact, knowing that progress is only achieved by working together – with our customers, and with each other.
* **Deliver for Customers:** We put customers at the center of all we do. When we live our values – lead with safety, solving problems creatively, and owning our work together – the result is clear: we deliver exceptional value for our customers.


We’ve reached a unique point as a company: big enough to deliver broad capability and consistent performance, while striving to be nimbler and more responsive to our customers’ evolving needs. Come join Arcwood and be part of our legacy of environmental leadership! **Regional Account Manager, Channel Partners**  

As a Regional Account Manager, Channel Partners you will be responsible for outside sales, new business development, and account management, supporting all business services for Arcwood. Your efforts will be crucial in achieving our revenue and profitability goals while ensuring the highest quality and consistency in product and service delivery.  

This position offers a unique opportunity to build strong relationships with clients and make a significant impact on our success.* Prioritizes health and safety by adhering to policies, processes, and maintaining safe practices at all times
* Boosts sales revenue and profit by identifying new accounts and soliciting orders through personal sales calls, explaining services, and assessing customer needs
* Enhances sales revenue and profit from existing accounts through regular customer contact and communication about additional services
* Cultivates sales relationships with target accounts
* Prepares, submits, and interprets periodic reports on activities, sales volume, and expenses
* Participates in sales meetings and training programs; represents the company at trade shows, conventions, Chamber of Commerce events, and professional associations
* Stays informed on major environmental regulatory changes, industry trends, and competitive conditions
* Demonstrates the ability to adapt to CORE business and customer categorization
* Manages Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) to less than 45 days
* Works with customers to profile service time frames, ensuring quality and customer satisfaction with current offerings; resolves any customer concerns
* Negotiates pricing and contract requirements
* Completes the annual sales revenue budget and key customer initiatives
* Prepares, submits, and interprets periodic reports on activities, sales volume, and expenses; manages and controls sales expenses, ensuring timely submission of business expenses
* Possesses a comprehensive understanding of the Company’s service offerings across all business lines provided to customers
* Travels up to 80% of the time, with overnight stays required
* Takes on additional duties as assigned to support the team and organization

  

* 3\+ years of proven industry related sales experience (required) \-OR\-
* In lieu of degree, 7\+ years of proven industry related sales experience (required)

We're hiring someone to build a rewarding sales career with the training, coaching, and uncapped earning potential to back it up.

As a Sales Representative, you'll lead the entire customer journey. This is a full\-cycle role: you’ll manage inbound leads, diagnose exterior damage, educate homeowners, and guide them through everything from proposal to signed contract. *Training \& Career Growth:*

From day one, you're invested in through a structured development path designed to turn new reps into top performers.

* Initial onboarding: a structured start that gets you up to speed on our process, systems, and expectations before you're on your own
* Product training: deep, hands\-on knowledge of roofing, siding, windows, and gutters so you can speak to homeowners with real credibility

*What You'll Actually Be Doing:*

* Running company\-provided appointments sourced through marketing efforts
* Performing roof, siding, window, and gutter inspections to accurately assess damage and scope of work
* Educating homeowners on products, solutions, and the insurance claims process where applicable
* Preparing estimates and proposals, then negotiating and closing sales
* Following up with prospects to keep your pipeline moving
* Managing projects from signed contract through completion, delivering an exceptional customer experience at every step
* Building a base of referral and repeat business over time

*You're Our Person If:*

* You're comfortable initiating conversations and building trust with homeowners
* You have a strong work ethic and are self\-motivated
* You're coachable, curious, and eager to learn
* You thrive in a performance\-based environment
* You have strong organizational and time\-management skills
* You hold a valid driver's license and have reliable transportation

*Even Better If...*

* You have outside sales or in\-home sales experience
* You've worked in home improvement, construction, or insurance restoration

The Tour Operations Coordinator will report directly to the Chief Operating Officer and play a key role in the planning and preparation of our events.

This position will be responsible for managing venue and hotel logistics from initial sourcing through final reconciliation. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable managing multiple events simultaneously, confident communicating with hotels and venues, and capable of maintaining accurate budgets, contracts, deadlines, and operational documentation.

Strong follow\-through, attention to detail, financial awareness, and the ability to proactively identify potential issues are essential for success in this role.

new_jobs.title: Virtual Sales Representative - Oncology - West
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 6,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next\-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start\-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!


Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self\-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

 **Job Description**  

The **Virtual Sales Representative (VSR)** will be responsible for marketing and selling pharmaceutical products via teleconference and/or telephone to targeted health care offices and providers. They will provide impactful core selling messages, materials, and samples as part of their remote engagements.
